notes.title: Healthy Food vs. Junk Food
notes.notes:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/7a8ce5e5611c5770222f7c9c5ea260deb06ad46a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Trovians, it’s time to take sides: the ultimate food feud has begun! Delegates from the Medieval Highlands are here to champion healthy eats, while Candoria stands proudly behind sweet and savory junk food. But wait… the [b]Skeleton Clan[/b] has arrived with their grape trade to [i]stir the pot[/i] even further.

[/p][previewyoutube="keaN8c5rctI;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[b]Here’s what you can expect[/b]:

🥦🍩 Pick a side: Support Healthy Food or Junk Food by crafting your banner and showing your colors.
🍇 Gather & donate grapes: Choose wisely each day as you back your faction.
🌍 Feed denizens in Adventure Worlds: Share your faction’s food to earn ballots.
🗳️ Cast your vote: Deposit your ballots in the Hub and help decide which cuisine reigns supreme!

The Healthy Food vs. Junk Food event runs [b]until September 23, 2025, at 11:00 UTC[/b].

Cast your vote, feed your faction, and decide which taste rules Trove! 

[i]Seasoned Greetings[/i],
Your Trove Team.[/p]

notes.title: Sunfest 2025
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/aa6ec8cdeabb12c3d4e99adba00ebfc1f1f6f88d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Trove is turning 10 this year, and you know we couldn’t let that happen without going all out. [b]Sunfest is back[/b], bigger and brighter than ever, [b]running for the entire month of July[/b] and packed with quests, rewards, and… [b]Yabaki[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]🗓️ [b]Event Timeline[/b]:[/p][p]Phase 1: July 1–8[/p][p]Phase 2: July 8–15[/p][p]Phase 3: July 15–31[/p][p][/p][p]Across all three phases, you’ll be able to earn many brand-new mounts, allies, wings, skins, and much much more.[/p][previewyoutube="FWqjG1qXos8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]You’ll follow a questline that sends you all over the Hub and beyond. Meet the three houses, do their daily tasks, donate goodies, and watch the story unfold. Each day you play, you’ll earn Sunfest Sigils, crafting mats, and our favorite little party bombs: [b]Yaba-Nata Pinatas[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Yaba-Nata Pinatas aren’t just for show. Every time you throw one, your name goes into a [b]raffle[/b]. At the end of Sunfest, we’ll randomly pick [b]10 winners[/b] per platform to receive [b]Yabaki, the Cast Shadow[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]• You can earn 2 pinatas per daily quest, across all three houses.[/p][p]• You’ll also find them in our in-game shop until August 1, 2025, at 11 AM UTC, and some other sources we'll tease later.[/p][p][/p][p]Looking for one more way to get your hands on Yabaki? We’re also running a [b]special giveaway[/b] on our socials, [url="https://www.trionworlds.com/trove/en/2025/06/27/return-of-the-shadow-yabaki-giveaway/"]head over and enter now[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for 10 amazing years. Let’s celebrate this decade together! 🎂[/p][p][/p][p]Your Trove Team![/p]

Trovians, we are glad to announce the return of Twitch Drops for Trove! 📽️

What?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/ea04260bb44f211fad9bbbb9f7a8d3fadc342446.png[/img]

By watching your favorite streamers play Trove on Twitch, you will be able to receive the following rewards:

Watch Trove for 1 hour and claim the reward: Streamer Dream 1*.
Watch Trove for 2 hours and claim the reward: Streamer Dream 2*.
Watch Trove for 3 hours and claim the reward: Dev Dream*.
Watch Trove for 4 hours and claim the reward: Streamer Dream 3*.
Watch Trove for 5 hours and claim the reward: 10x Super Style Stash*.
Watch Trove for 6 hours and claim the reward: Scorpiyum*.
Watch Trove for 7 hours and claim the reward: Blue Trovian Ranger*.

*Reward is limited to one per account.

How?

To take advantage of Twitch Drops, properly link your Glyph and Twitch accounts. You can find all the information on how to do this by clicking >> [url=https://www.trionworlds.com/trove/en/game/twitch-drops/]here [/url]<<!
Once you’ve successfully linked your accounts, watch any of the Trove streams below to receive the rewards listed above, based on your watch time.

*Please note that we are unable to accept everybody. If you have been selected, we will reach out to you within 1 week.

[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1tpRRkpmGuVvxDY6I7M41FpIDbIEdW-uOefYwOVAkKr8/edit?usp=sharing]Watch any of these streamers to receive Twitch Drops![/url]

Ahoy Trovians,

We are excited to announce that the "Release the Kraken" update is now live on PC! 🌊🦑

Get your fishing pole ready, have your tentacle repellant on hand, and check out what’s new:
🦑 The Deep Kraken Titan Boss
🎣 New fish eager to be caught
🎣 New, very picky fish that might not be that easy to catch
🦑 New 5-Star Dungeon
🦑 New buffs, collectibles, and more!

[previewyoutube=WZdiqLYHKlQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: How do I sign up to play Trove from China?
notes.notes:
[h2]Hello everyone! [/h2]

In order to provide you with a better and more convenient gaming experience, we will introduce you to the process of how to register and link to your Steam account and eventually enter the game to play![h3] In the middle of this, we recommend you to prepare the VPN to avoid encountering connection problems during the process.[/h3]

1.	First of all, please download Trove directly from the Steam, yes, we are free to play!

2.	After the game is downloaded, please use the booster to accelerate the game of Trove, you can start the game directly through the booster, or you can find Trove in the game library and click to start the game, see the picture below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/266991e3f30c9b8a7e4a5998c17ddb8ee3288236.png[/img]

3.	After clicking start game, the in-game client will start, if you already have a game account, you are welcome to log in and play the game directly. If you don't have a game account, please click Create New Account to create one.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/f3b70676639898202969a7587539ed001782f1e4.png[/img]

4.	After clicking [Create New Account], a new webpage will pop up, you can switch the language to Chinese in the upper right corner to facilitate reading and continue the next step. [h3](It is recommended that you use VPN to avoid problems with the page not loading.)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/0cd9e35b2f18df792e128bebb566084555a803a3.png[/img]

5.	Under the Chinese registration interface, please fill in your email address and password. (In order to avoid registration failure, we recommend you to use Google email address instead of QQ email address.)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/29d342ef914e80e76de5fa0fb027068df329cb6c.png[/img]

6.	After the registration is submitted, your registered mailbox will receive an email for confirmation, please click the link to confirm, the registration can be completed.

7.	Now you can go back to the game client to log in to your GLYPH account and link it with your Steam account!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/e37c75332bd945312a77b4fa1f7883e70021653c.png[/img]

8.	If the client linking is unsuccessful, you need to open the GLYPH website (https://www.glyph.net/en/) through your browser after using VPN.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/91bd4d47380f009cf663dc9571b596492538cff6.png[/img]

9.	Find the game Trove on the website and select the account login.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/982966aa12dc130ab76ae4af1623a93dc83ceb5c.png[/img]
10.	Below is the web login page, please fill in your registered email address and account password to complete the login. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/c2f21e9f7260ad2f7ad0b37c55d5de257253a812.png[/img]

11.	If you are logging in from a new region, you will need to enter the verification code you received in your email in order to log in.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/5e2a383d657b8537c66a67229ba9b3bdb9553ff2.png[/img]

12.	Once you have successfully logged in, please go to Account Linking under the ACCOUNT tab to complete the linking of your Steam account.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/a645b42a26fe65b7d710d6e42fe3a38300ad5d9b.png[/img]

13.	As shown in the picture below, please click [Connect with Steam] to complete the linking with your Steam account.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/08fb159e7a64e7d066c9a330ae95230ba33b9494.png[/img]

14.	After successful linking, your page will be shown as below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/7c936a15a19b91aa179594ed5be2f69dee31b02b.png[/img]

15.	After the web linking is successful, we recommend you to continue to use the booster to play, to avoid the situation that the client reminds you of the Steam account linking again. However, if you are still reminded of your Steam account linking in the client even though you have successfully bound your Steam account on the web and used the booster, we recommend that you uninstall the game and reinstall it.

16.	After the Steam account linking is completed, you can select the appropriate server region next to the [PLAY] button. After selecting, if there is an update for the game, please click Update Game. If you already have the latest version, please click [PLAY] to start playing the game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/8b4cdb6bf37c8a226a2efa39071f2105313b8ed0.png[/img]

17.	Welcome to Trove! Please enjoy your gaming time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/779088aa639eeae9fe5508d1f8c6930152668c97.png[/img]

notes.title: Delve into Darkness: Building Contest
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/eb909c7a8827de172d11e949c2cd3cb959a753ad.jpg[/img]

Trovians, get ready to create the eeriest clubs and the most haunting cornerstones. The shadows are calling, and we want to see your chilling creations. Dive into darkness and build your way to terrifying glory! 🏰🌙

[b]How do I enter?[/b]

1. Head over to your Trove cornerstone or club and create the spookiest build you can! It must include Shadow’s Eve 2023 decoration items.
2. Snap a screenshot in-game featuring your spooky build.
3. Share your screenshot on our official Discord server’s channel #delve-into-darkness or on social media (Facebook, X, or Instagram) using the hashtag #TroveSpookyContest.
4. Your entry must include your character name, platform (PC/PS3/PS4/XBOX/SWITCH), region (NA/EU), and entry type (cornerstone/club).

[b]Are there any rules?[/b]

1. Content that is inappropriate or offensive is strictly forbidden.
2. Your build can be on a cornerstone or club, but only one entry is allowed per player
3. A minimal amount of image editing is allowed, however, the build must remain fully visible.
4. Creations that you didn’t make or do not belong to you are strictly forbidden.
5. Entries that don’t include Character Name, Platform, and Region are considered void and will be unable to receive a reward.

[b]What are the Rewards?[/b]

Cornerstone rewards:
3000 Credits for three (3) Cornerstone participants.

Club rewards:
3000 Credits for three (3) Club participants.

Entry submissions close on November 10, 2023, and winners will be announced on November 20, 2023!*

[url=https://forum.glyph.net/terms-of-participation-contest-en/]General Terms of Participation apply.[/url]

notes.title: The Fluxion Update is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/38ef9c74fe501c1fca010d48afcb9d6f20f7af0d.jpg[/img]

Trovians!

We're super excited to bring you the latest update, Fluxion, packed with awesome new features and improvements that'll make your Trove adventures even more epic! Let's dive right in and check out what's in store for you:

💥 Fluxion
💥 Castle Catastra
💥 Cosmic Primordial Dragon
💥 Master’s Autoscriptor
💥 Badge Tracking
💥 & Much More!

We heard your concerns about Luxion, so we've introduced a brand-new system called Fluxion: You can find Fluxion, a community-oriented version of Luxion, right in the hub, after completing a short introductory quest. Both Fluxion and Luxion coexist but appear on separate rotations. Luxion continues to appear on weekends, while Fluxion appears Tuesday through Thursday, alternating between voting and buying rounds. When you engage with Fluxion, you can vote on what you'd like to see being offered. Your votes will be cast using flux, and you can vote multiple times, though each subsequent vote will cost a bit more. Once an item wins a round on Fluxion, it won't be available for the next round but may appear in subsequent rounds. Don't worry if your favorite item doesn't win, your votes will carry over to the next time it's up for voting. Just remember to log in during the voting period to have your say!

In Castle Catastra, a new delve biome, you'll embark on an exciting adventure through the halls of Fiona Catastra's domain. Your mission? Seek out the legendary Cat's Eye Gemeralds, which you can trade for some seriously amazing rewards!

But that's not all! We've made some other additions and fixes to enhance your gameplay. You'll find a shiny new Badges section in the Adventures UI, making it easier for you to track your progress. Plus, among many other additional updates, we made several adjustments to some dungeons based on your feedback.

[url=https://www.trionworlds.com/trove/en/?page_id=31917]Read through the full patch notes here.[/url]

We can’t wait to see you in-game, Trovians!

Your Trove Team!

notes.title: Green Game Jam - Winners Announcement!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/3544b833c7839691dbb8a1318ad14bc08c894e24.jpg[/img]

Hello Trovians!

Today our take on this year’s Green Game Jam is coming to an end, and we would like to take a moment to step back and highlight some of our favourite moments. Reflecting on the incredible sustainability efforts of the past month, we urge all Trovians to persist on the path of sustainability in their everyday lives. Keep using those green life hacks and making a difference for our planet! 🌍💚

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/e73f963d1070a076f307eb5abbf0bd3b9635972b.jpg[/img]

[b]One full month of cleaning the Trove oceans![/b]

Since the start of the Green Game Jam, Trovians have been hard at work to make the Trove oceans a lot cleaner with the help of Qubesly and our beloved turtles, cleaning over 640.000 Salty Trash in just a month!

We’re truly inspired by our community’s dedication to ocean cleanliness!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/1e4f1a4581d410818e631e826563a7a5483de4f6.png[/img]

On that note, we will also be rewarding the Trovians with the highest initiative with a handsome reward!
Check below to find out the winners!

1st place – BleachFix | 11th place – DJ+P1UM
2nd place – skiOOS | 12th place – Brunose
3rd place – Grimmjowl | 13th place – Brais
4th place – silberrgat | 14th place – duotexone
5th place – Simtendo123 | 15th place – unyael
6th place – LethargicNewt | 16th place – zLoveName
7th place – jasiek9741 | 17th place – Trubel
8th place – Mark23batsaz | 18th place – hashtagRobbi3
9th place – terresumo | 19th place – MACROPYRE
10th place – RUSOKN123 | 20th place – niglos

If you’re wondering about our Gleam.io winners, please check your email on July 6, 2023 to check if you’re one of the lucky winners! 💚

[b]A truly sustainable month![/b]

Throughout the month of June, we took it upon ourselves to post plenty of sustainability lifehacks to help our fellow Trovians become greener in their everyday activities!

Here are but a few of our favourite ones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/745696d761c8021dabc73b936d2128b6a28d5a17.jpg[/img]

[b]Harness the solar clothes-drying spell[/b]: Line-dry your laundry using sunlight and fresh air to save energy and reduce your carbon footprint. Just as your Trove character harnesses the power of nature, you can do the same in your daily life. Spread the word about this simple, eco-friendly practice and encourage others to join you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/871caecdaa6da0b6023023f10f60f71a819e7690.jpg[/img]

Invoke the water-saving toothbrushing charm: Turn off the faucet while brushing your teeth to conserve water and make every drop count. Share this simple yet effective habit with friends and family, encouraging them to join you in safeguarding our precious water resources.

These are just some of the things you can do to help our planet. We’re certain there are more lifehacks out there waiting to be discovered, like [url=https://www.facebook.com/559540232940094/posts/601318918762225]upcycling[/url] or adopting a [url=https://www.facebook.com/559540232940094/posts/593589889535128]meatless[/url] diet!

We are thankful to each and every single Trovian for taking part in this year’s Green Game Jam!

We’ll see you at next year’s Green Game Jam and at our next sustainability event!

Green regards,
Your Trove Team.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/e44dc84328647ee21c553319d48032faf7a7eee5.jpg[/img]

Hey Trovians!
Welcome to the Green Game Jam!

Starting today, take on a ton of fun in-game challenges for the whole month, help clear the Trove seas and lands from garbage and get rewarded, until July 5, 2023!

[h2]New green questline![/h2]

Qubesly has been incredibly busy of late removing trash and junk all over the place, but he now more than ever needs your help to clean as much waste as possible!

Head over to the Fae Forest and look out for Adventure Outposts where you will find some quite curious Bin Chickens who will gladly give you Tidal Treasures in exchange for certain items!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/1e4f1a4581d410818e631e826563a7a5483de4f6.png[/img]

Make use of the Tital Treasures to exchange various items at the Recycling Recombobulator, like the mounts Six-Pack and Magestica, which work both on land and water and hold them close, you will need them to get rid of the Garbage Buoys found in the Treasure Isles biomes!

[h2]New and returning rewards![/h2]

The Green Game Jam brings you the aforementioned Six-Pack and Magestica mounts, along with some new allies that increase your garbage collection rate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/01ae91a0b137e0b92ba6da93ef480b6f9307c9c7.png[/img]

Get yourself the Bin Chicken Commission Fountain fixture for your Cornerstone or Club world, the Sapling Sower and the Hyper Tree Friend returning rewards from the Recyclic Recombobulator!

[h2]Collect Tidal Treasures for massive earnings![/h2]

By actively participating in the Green Game Jam activities and crafting as many Tidal Treasures as you can throughout the duration of the event, you will be able to win massive Credit rewards as a thank-you for your efforts!

Players from 1st to 5th place will receive 10000 Credits each!
Players from 6th to 10th place will receive 5000 Credits each!
Players from 11th to 20th place will receive 2500 Credits each!

It’s high time to join the clean-up initiative Trovians!

Head over to the Fae Forests as soon as possible and help Qubesly along with other fellow Trove players to remove as much garbage as you can!

[h2]Take on even more challenges on Gleam.io![/h2]

You heard right!
We’re celebrating the Green Game Jam by challenging our community with a ton of fun quests on Gleam.io for a chance to earn amazing rewards!

[h2]How do I enter?[/h2]

Starting today, click [url=https://gleam.io/PEGMm/green-game-jam-trove]here[/url] to access the [url=https://gleam.io/PEGMm/green-game-jam-trove]Gleam.io page[/url] and take on several and diverse challenges!
Entries will close on July 5, 2023, so don’t wait too long!

[h2]What are the rewards?[/h2]

A lot of amazing surprises will be up for grabs for our lucky Gleam.io winners!
Check it out!

1 Winner will receive a Big Green Game Jam Pack!
1 Winner will receive a Medium Green Game Jam Pack!
1 Winner will receive a Small Green Game Jam Pack!
25 Winners will receive three (3) Dev Dream Boxes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/28f70e909ccb1933f4b9c5b153e93ed8573e500c.png[/img]

Head over to [url=https://gleam.io/PEGMm/green-game-jam-trove]Gleam.io[/url] right now and don’t miss the chance to earn any of these amazing rewards!

[url=https://forum.glyph.net/terms-of-participation-contest-en/]General Terms of Participation apply.[/url]

Sustainable regards,
Your Trove team

Dear Trovians, 

The much-awaited [b]St. Qubeslick event[/b] is back in town, and we're hunting the legendary Luckbeast!

Meet Qubesly in the hub to start the quest to craft two limited-time foods: the mouth-watering St. Qubeslick’s Delite and the sumptuous St. Qubeslick’s Feast. These foods not only give you a magic find boost but also make the mysterious Luckbeast and Fluxbeast visible. The hunt for these elusive creatures will take you through the exotic Jurassic Jungle and the vibrant Neon City biome, where you can obtain the Luckbeast and Fluxbeast allies and mounts, as well as the adorable Tricera-Flux and Tricera-Luck allies and mounts.

If you're lucky enough to spot the treasure boxes in the Treasure Isles, revealed by the St. Qubeslick foods, grab them to earn event currency and spend them for a chance to see Sir O'Lucky at Unity Shrines, who is offering a random assortment of previous event rewards and exclusive items.

The St. Qubeslick event is an extraordinary opportunity, so don't miss your chance to be a part of the festivities and acquire some truly unique items!

In addition to all the exciting activities during the St. Qubeslick event, we're also giving away a special log-in bonus for players who had their account created [b]before March 7, 11 AM UTC[/b]. If you log in from March 7, 11 AM UTC to March 9, 11 AM UTC, you'll receive [b]five Shamrockin Pinatas[/b] to celebrate St. Qubeslick! 

[i]Unfortunately, accounts created after March 7, 11 AM UTC will not be eligible to receive the Pinatas. [/i]

May luck be with you! ☘️

Happy St. Qubeslick’s to everybody!

Best regards,
The Trove Team!

Hey Trovians on Steam!

notes.title: Trove is eligible for 'Labor of Love'-Award!

Dear Trovians,

We're giving thanks during this special time of year to you, our players, and to celebrate the achievements we've built together over the years. [b]The Steam Awards[/b] are here, and we are humbled to be eligible for a nomination for our 'Labor of Love', Trove!

As Trove's 7th anniversary year, we have added a new class, the stunning Solarion, along with many magical class reworks, updates, and events. Be sure to cast your nominees for your favorite voxel adventure MMO and share your memorable 2022 moments on our socials!

[b]How To Nominate?[/b]
1. Go to the Steam store.
2. Click on the “Nominate your favorite Games in the 2022 Steam Awards” button.
3. Click the “Labor of Love” award card in the menu.
4. Chose your favorite game.
5. Click Save.

Thank you for your continued love and support!

Your Trove Team!

notes.title: Trove – Sunrise is now live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/9c5ccc79e27c1594b3abf0a2d6440321c60f23f9.jpg[/img]

[b]Trovians[/b],
We’re pleased to introduce the Sunrise patch, introducing a new class, [b]Solarion[/b], a new biome, [b]Sundered Uplands[/b], a new difficulty rank, [b]Uber-11[/b], to challenge everyone, and, of course, new rewards in the form of [b]Crystal Gems[/b].  

When introducing [b]Crystal Gems[/b], we wanted to be respectful of the time players have already invested in their existing gems – no one wants to throw away all the time and resources they’ve put into getting a perfectly stacked [b]Gem[/b]!  As a result, we’ve introduced a way for players to upgrade existing [b]Max Level Stellar Gems[/b] into [b]Crystal Gems[/b], retaining their stats and bonuses.

[previewyoutube=fQ43VrphcJY;full][/previewyoutube]

Additionally, there is much more to discover with this update: updates to the store, subclass power rank updates, bug fixes & much more!

Embrace your inner fire with the heat of the Solarion and reach new heights this summer with our newest update: “Trove – Sunrise”!

Enjoy an overview of the complete patch notes below:
🔥 Solarion
🔥 New biome: Sundered Uplands
🔥 Crystal Gems
🔥 Uber 11 Worlds
🔥 Atlas Updates
🔥 Subclass Power Rank Updates
🔥 Store Updates
🔥 Additional Updates

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/4f5c7d3de71155522fcd742f0f1df1f8b7692b40.png[/img]

• Solarions, as servants of the Sun Goddess, work together with their phoenix to distribute Damage over Time Effects and deal out physical damage.  Solarions use bows to shoot their enemies while the phoenix rushes into melee to deliver bows.  Solarions are really fired up!

• Solarion can be obtained through crafting on the Chaos Crafter, the Sundered Uplands Workbench, or one of the Solarion packs. The Solarion class cannot be obtained through Class Coins or the Sweet Sixteen Pack.

• Passive Ability – Phoenix Radiance
- The Solarion gains Divine Radiance and energy from their damage over time effects.  Divine Radiance increases the number of projectiles fired from basic attacks.  Energy is used to power their Prismatic Blast.  The Solarion summons a phoenix to aid them in battle.  Phoenix’s attacks apply a damage over time that deals 250% damage every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds, additionally granting Divine Radiance and Energy back to the Solarion.  When Phoenix dies it will spawn an egg at its location.  The egg will heal itself and explode once at max health, dealing 550% damage to nearby enemies as well as applying its damage over time effect and respawning the Phoenix.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/94fcea03ec5b4adf3bed57428f06efa36771fa09.gif[/img]

• Basic Attack
- The Solarion sends out a shot from their bow dealing 175 % damage to enemies in front of them. Any of The Solarion’s damage over time effects are refreshed.

• Primary Ability – “Solar Flare”
- The Solarion fires a charged explosive shot that increases the area of effect the longer it is charged.  Solar Flare applies a Damage over Time effect that deals 150% damage every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds, additionally granting Divine Radiance and Energy back to the Solarion.  The Solarion gains slow fall while the ability is active and for a short time afterward.  Phoenix will target enemies damaged by Solar Flare.

• Secondary Ability – “Guiding Light”
- Summons a pillar of light at the target location that expands over time and deals 100 % damage to enemies 150% damage every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds in the area while healing friendly targets.  Applies a Damage over Time effect dealing 250% damage every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds, additionally granting Divine Radiance and Energy to the Solarion.  If Phoenix is an egg, this will cause the egg to explode faster.  This ability can be cast in rapid succession, with up to 3 Guiding Lights placed at one time.

• Ultimate – “Prismatic Blast”
- Continually creates a blast of energy, dealing 400% damage to enemies in an area around the Solarion.  Each blast costs energy and gives the Solarion a damage buff that stacks up to 5 times.  This buff lasts until Prismatic Blast ends.  Toggles off once Energy is depleted.

• Solarion Subclass “Phoenix Fire”
- Up to 5,000 Power Rank: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to cause an explosion dealing 100% damage that applies a damage over time effect to enemies, dealing 50% damage every 0.25 seconds for 5 seconds.  Damage done by this effect restores energy to the user.
- 5,000 Power Rank: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to cause an explosion dealing 125% damage that applies a damage over time effect to enemies, dealing 50% damage every 0.25 seconds for 5 seconds.  Damage done by this effect restores energy to the user.
- 10,000 Power Rank: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to cause an explosion dealing 150% damage that applies a damage over time effect to enemies, dealing 50% damage every 0.25 seconds for 5 seconds.  Damage done by this effect restores energy to the user.
- 15,000 Power Rank: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to cause an explosion dealing 200% damage that applies a damage over time effect to enemies, dealing 50% damage every 0.25 seconds for 5 seconds.  Damage done by this effect restores energy to the user.
- 20,000 Power Rank: Basic attacks have a 25% chance to cause an explosion dealing 225% damage that applies a damage over time effect to enemies, dealing 75% damage every 0.25 seconds for 5 seconds.  Damage done by this effect restores energy to the user.
- 25,000 Power Rank: Basic attacks have a 33% chance to cause an explosion dealing 250% damage that applies a damage over time effect to enemies, dealing 75% damage every 0.25 seconds for 5 seconds.  Damage done by this effect restores energy to the user.
- 30,000 Power Rank: Basic attacks have a 33% chance to cause an explosion dealing 275% damage that applies a damage over time effect to enemies, dealing 75% damage every 0.25 seconds for 5 seconds.  Damage done by this effect restores energy to the user.
- 35,000 Power Rank: Basic attacks have a 33% chance to cause an explosion dealing 300% damage that applies a damage over time effect to enemies, dealing 85% damage every 0.25 seconds for 5 seconds.  Damage done by this effect restores energy to the user.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Basic attacks have a 40% chance to cause an explosion dealing 350% damage that applies a damage over time effect to enemies, dealing 100% damage every 0.25 seconds for 5 seconds.  Damage done by this effect restores energy to the user.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/4fb2b7f134d0039729e08a984d81d1c418fd68bc.gif[/img]

• Hidden Effects for the Solarion include:
- Guiding Flight: Prismatic Blast and Guiding Light now also apply the Solar Wings Slowfall Effect.
- Solar Stance: This will remove the Solar Wings effect, now applying a Damage Reduction buff for a short time instead.
- Prismatic Chain: Prismatic Blast causes enemies damaged by it to also fire off a Prismatic Blast, damaging nearby enemies.

• The Nocturnal Nighthawk costume has been added to the Shadowy Workbench for 4 Despoiled Divinity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/522041ebd9dba176b13931c30f08d31c887c8dff.png[/img]
• A new biome has been added. Available as soon as U-1 Adventure Worlds but primarily found in U-7 Adventure Worlds, the Sundered Uplands have distinct upper and lower levels.

• In addition to their biome-wide Flight Suppression Field, through reckless exploitation of the world around them, the Irradiant Sky Giants have empowered both themselves and the Ashen creatures arising from their fallout. Creatures in the Sundered Uplands are significantly more difficult when compared to neighboring biomes. Players will have to utilize all the extra consumables available to overcome this difficulty!

• Explore the somber Ashen Wastes, fighting enemies left behind by the Irradiant Sky Giants in their pursuit to steal the land.  Mind the blastflowers and defeat Ashen Devourers for special rewards.

• Rise to the heights of the Uplands, fighting the Irradiant Sky Giants and their minions in pursuit of treasure.  Watch out for the boots and mines looking to kick any players back down to the surface.

• Dungeons can appear in both the Ashen Wastes and the heights of the Uplands.  The compass and map have been updated to show an up or down arrow to indicate their location.

• Outposts can appear throughout the Sundered Uplands.  These outposts provide Personal Chests, Flask Refillers, Loot Collectors, Fungi Adventures, and a variety of merchants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/a8406af9fdad553066e0c71de54d68b05f5b9313.gif[/img]

• Fungus Scrollpeddlers appear in outposts within the Ashen Wastes.  For the price of Ashfern Sporelings or Cubits, players can now purchase consumable scrolls which grant buffs within the Sundered Uplands.  These effects will count down even while the player is offline.  The following scrolls are available:
- Freedom of Flight – This temporarily removes the Flight Suppression Field present in Sundered Uplands, allowing players to use any mount or wings with full effectiveness.  This scroll stacks with all other scrolls.  These scrolls are always available at landing pads in the Sundered Uplands.
- Physical Damage++/Magical Damage++ - When fighting in Sundered Uplands, these occasionally create Physical Damage or Magic Damage buffs which increase the relevant damage by 75% for a short duration.  These scrolls will not stack with each other.
- Misc – There are several of these scrolls available, including scrolls that give +50 Jump, reduce incoming damage by 15%, or even +resource collection scrolls.  Players can only have one of these “Misc” scrolls active at a time, and they all only apply to Sundered Uplands.

• Different versions of these scrolls are available.  Bronze scrolls will last for 1 hour, Silver scrolls will last for 1 day, and Gold scrolls will last for 3 days.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/c7e5baeae725502be00462d2205a1f6c4b6c8faf.gif[/img]

• The effects of scrolls can replace each other, but only at the same rarity or higher.  A Silver Scroll can replace another Silver or Bronze Scroll, but cannot replace a Gold Scroll.

• Fungi Recipetakers spawn in the heights of the Uplands outposts, trading in either Ashen or Irradiant scrolls for other goods, including limited amounts of Sundercharge Crystals.

• Fungi Thingshapers spawn in outposts across the Sundered Uplands, trading in Ashen Sporelings for other goods.

• While inside the Sundered Uplands, the flight is affected by the gravity technology of the Irradiant Giants, causing gliding distance to be reduced.  This effect increases in higher Uber worlds and can be overcome by using Freedom of Flight scrolls or using wings or a flying mount crafted from the Sundered Uplands Workbench.

• Explore the Ashen Wastes to find new resources, including Ashfern Sporelings, Unnatural Devices, and Emberslag Ore, while the heights of the Uplands contain Irradiant Powercells and Irradiant Ore.

• Like most creatures, enemies in Sundered Uplands will rarely drop Trophies.  These Trophies can be composted itoacquire Ashen Souls or Irradiant Souls.  These souls are used for crafting on the Sundered Uplands Workbench.

• A new invader replaces the Shadow Giant inside the Sundered Uplands.

• 5-Star dungeons appear in the Sundered Uplands.  Found starting in Uber-10, these new dungeons are wave events, started and progressed by interacting with the Master Console.  Players will have between 30 and 60 seconds to rest up between each wave.  Waves will either consist of 5 challenges in rooms scattered throughout the dungeon or 1 singular boss found in the main hall.  While a variety of bosses exist, only a single boss will appear for a given 5-Star dungeon.

• Each time a single boss spawns, all creatures spawned within the 5-Star dungeon will permanently increase their Darkness.

• After boss waves, an Unstable Sunder-Ark Cache will spawn, which requires a Sunder-Ark Cache Key to open (craftable at the Sundered Uplands workbench). This chest has an increased chance to drop Crystal 4 gear.  Crystal 3 gear can additionally be earned by opening Sunder-Ark Caches in Prime Uber-10 Worlds.  Delve Crystal drop rates/methods have not changed.

• Two allies, Tszup and Sundered Shard, and two mounts, Watt's Saucer and Sundered Sunderer, can be found rarely in 5-Star boss chests.  These can also be crafted on the Sundered Uplands Workbench.

• Players can receive up to 40 Sundercharge Crystals by defeating unique boss waves each week.

• Most of the 5-Star dungeon is destructible, with key walkways and fight areas remaining impervious to damage.

• The Sundered Uplands Workbench can be found on Outposts and allows players to craft collectablcollectibless useful items for the biome.  Sundercharged Crystals can also be donated at this workbench.  Sundered Uplands Workbenches can be crafted at the Builder’s Workbench as well as on themselves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/ed2db09d3ae7a2917c39aedf87e75b43c0a20a1b.gif[/img]

• New workbenches can be found from enemies roaming the Sundered Uplands – the Devourer Empowerer, the Ashen Blastflower Empowerer, and the Irradiant Sky Admiral Empowerer.  Each of these benches can be used to gain a buff for one hour that empowers some enemies in the Sundered Uplands.

• To empower a creature, simply attack them while the buff is active and they’re above 75% health.  They will increase in size and fully heal to signal they have been empowered.  Once an enemy is empowered they will itin that way for 3 minutes.  Empowered enemies take less damage, deal more damage, and gain access to special attacks.

• When empowered, Ashen Blastflowers still explode but now have a chance to spawn an Empowered Ashen Thresher in addition to other potential spawns.

• Defeating Empowered Enemies in any Uber can reward an Empowered trophy along with three possible tradable allies – the Ashen Nibbler, Irradiant Songbird, and Ashen Creepy Crawly.  Defeating Empowered Enemies in Uber-11 can additionally reward Foraged and Irradiant Dragon Egg Fragments.

• A terraformer for Sundered Uplands can be crafted at the Wheel of Seasons and the Sundered Uplands Workbench.

• New styles, recipes, and decorations have been introduced and can be obtained from Sundered Uplands.

• The generic “Uber 7” portal is now a “Sundered Uplands (Uber-7) World” portal.

• Sundered Uplands will appear more frequently in Prime worlds by default.

• Three new dragons can be acquired in the Sundered Uplands:
- Budgiz, the Forager is a new Legendary Dragon and can be acquired through the dragon effigy or crafting egg fragments.  Foraged Dragon Egg Fragments for Budgiz can be acquired by defeating Empowered Threshers and Empowered Devourers in the Ashen Wastes of the Sundered Uplands in U-11 worlds.
- Zeuztian, the Eternal Irradiance is a new Legendary Dragon and can be acquired through the dragon effigy or crafting egg fragments.  Irradiant Dragon Egg Fragments for Zeuzhan can be found by defeating Empowered Irradiant Sky Admirals in the Sundered Uplands.
- Ariel, the Ashen Reborn is a new Ancestral Dragon.  Stained Dragon Egg Fragments for Ariel can be found by defeating powerful bosses in 5-Star dungeons in the Sundered Uplands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/4f331a57fffd7c852304080a3855560f7cb1dd00.png[/img]
• Crystal Gems can now be found in Uber-11 worlds and have a maximum level of 30.

• Max level StMax-levels can be upgraded into Crystal Gems by using a Crystal Gem Converter from the Gems tab in the character sheet.  

• Crystal Gem Converters can be purchased from the store for 1,500 credits or 15,000 cubits.  Alternatively, they can be crafted at the Sundered Uplands Workbench or Adventurer’s Workbench.

• Stellar Gems converted to Crystal Gems retain their power – a gem converted in this way will immediately become a Level 25 Crystal Gem.  They will retain existing stat bumps and any applied focuses. A Gem with applied focuses will retain the increases granted by those focuses.

• Leveling Crystal Gems will require new materials in the form of Gem Sparks. These can be crafted from Gem Dust on the Adventurer’s Workbench or the Sundered Uplands Workbench.

• New Crystal Empowered Gem Boxes can be constructed on the Adventurer’s Workbench or the Sundered Uplands Workbench.

• Shores of the Everdark now drops Radiant and Stellar Class Gems in Uber-8, while Stellar and Crystal Class Gems come from Uber-9.

• New Gem boxes can be found in Uber-10 and Uber-11. Uber-10 boxes drop stellar gems and dust. Uber-11 gem boxes have a rare chance to drop Crystal Gems and Gem Sparks which are needed for gem crafting.

• Gem Sparks can now be found in Gem Booster Boxes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/7228b5357bdc174daeb15921e8dc5b8da094483a.png[/img]
• Many additional Uber portals have been added to the Builder’s Crafting Bench, including Uber-11 World, Drowned (Uber-11) World, Cursed Skylands (Uber-11) World, and Igneous Islands (Uber-11) World.

• Crystal 4 gear can drop from 5-Star Dungeons in Uber-11 Geode Topside and Prime Worlds.

• Leviathan's Lairs in Uber 11 Geode Topside will spawn a random Leviathan that can also drop any Leviathan’s loot.

• Beginning in Uber-10, all adventure worlds now benefit from Light.  Geode Topside worlds still give benefits for Light starting at Uber-9.

• Uber-11 Worlds require 30,000 PR and 6,000 Light for entry.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/3f35bd54218ef9f5f0195b1d19506399228bdb0e.png[/img]
• The Atlas map has been adjusted to include Sundered Uplands (Uber-7) World.

• Elemental Worlds and Prime Worlds now only have one node on the Atlas.  

• Instead of highlighting individual nodes, players use a dropdown to determine what Uber Level the player wishes to travel to.

• This dropdown defaults to the highest difficulty the user can access.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/232ac819373fd4fae0b9f48a2326686495b0bcd9.png[/img]
• Subclass abilities have had new ranks added for 35,000 and 40,000 Power Rank.  Some abilities have been adjusted to be more effective.

• Boomeranger Subclass “Fae Companion”
- 35,000 Power Rank: Summons a fae companion that provides 45% healing when you are low on life.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Summons a fae companion that provides 50% healing when you are low on life.

• Bard Subclass “Personal Song”
- 35,000 Power Rank: 
- Jubilant Song: Movement Speed and Max Energy are increased by 17.5%.
- Peaceful Song: 6.5% life gain when dealing damage.
- Battle Song: Attack Speed and Critical damage are increased by 17.5%.
- 40,000 Power Rank: 
- Jubilant Song: Movement Speed and Max Energy are increased by 20%.
- Peaceful Song: 7.5% life gain when dealing damage.
- Battle Song: Attack Speed and Critical damage are increased by 20%.

• Candy Barbarian Subclass “Sugar Rush”
- 35,000 Power Rank: Damaging an enemy has a 40% chance to drop candy that increases attack and movement speed or healing.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Damaging an enemy has a 50% chance to drop candy that increases attack and movement speed or healing.

• Chloromancer Subclass “Prickly Persona”
- 35,000 Power Rank: Enemy attacks have a chance to cover you in thistles, returning 65% damage to attackers for 10 seconds.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Enemy attacks have a chance to cover you in thistles, returning 75% damage to attackers for 12 seconds.

• Dino Tamer Subclass “Research Net”
- 35,000 Power Rank: Critical hits have a 40% chance to root targets in place for 3 seconds.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Critical hits have a 45% chance to root targets in place for 4 seconds.

• Dracolyte Subclass “Burning Zealot”
- 35,000 Power Rank: Physical damage to enemies has a 25% chance to apply fire to them, dealing 30% damage every 0.1 seconds for 3 seconds.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Physical damage to enemies has a 30% chance to apply fire to them, dealing 40% damage every 0.1 seconds for 3 seconds.

• Fae Trickster Subclass “Sparkle Grenade”
- 35,000 Power Rank: Critical hits to enemies have a 30% chance to spawn a shiny bomb that deals 400% damage and stuns enemies.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Critical hits to enemies have a 40% chance to spawn a shiny bomb that deals 450% damage and stuns enemies.

• Gunslinger Subclass “Rain Destruction”
- 35,000 Power Rank: Damage dealt to enemies while airborne is increased by 7.5%.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Damage dealt to enemies while airborne is increased by 10%.

• Ice Mage Subclass “Glacial ward”
- 35,000 Power Rank: 30% Chance on damage received to activate a shield that lasts 5 seconds.  While active, movement speed, magic damage, and attack speed are increased by 25%.  Damage received that’s greater than 50% of the player’s health is absorbed.
- 40,000 Power Rank: 35% Chance on damage received to activate a shield that lasts 5 seconds.  While active, movement speed, magic damage, and attack speed are increased by 35%.  Damage received that’s greater than 50% of the player’s health is absorbed.

• Knight Subclass “Mounted Cavalry”
- Now additionally grants a shield that spawns at low health.
- Up to 5,000 Power Rank: Increased movement speed while riding ground-based mounts.  At low health gain a 25% damage reduction shield for a short time.
- 5,000 Power Rank: Increased movement speed while riding ground-based mounts.  At low health gain a 30% damage reduction shield for a short time.
- 10,000 Power Rank: Increased movement speed while riding ground-based mounts.  At low health gain a 35% damage reduction shield for a short time.
- 15,000 Power Rank: Increased movement speed while riding ground-based mounts.  At low health gain a 45% damage reduction shield for a short time.
- 20,000 Power Rank: Increased movement speed while riding ground-based mounts.  At low health gain a 55% damage reduction shield for a short time.
- 25,000 Power Rank: Increased movement speed while riding ground-based mounts.  At low health gain a 65% damage reduction shield for a short time.
- 30,000 Power Rank: Increased movement speed while riding ground-based mounts.  At low health gain a 65% damage reduction shield for a short time.
- 35,000 Power Rank: Increased movement speed while riding ground-based mounts.  At low health gain a 75% damage reduction shield for a short time.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Increased movement speed while riding ground-based mounts.  At low health gain an 85% damage reduction shield for a short time.

• Lunar Lancer Subclass “Sorta Crazy”
- 35,000 Power Rank: Chance during combat to transform and receive some of the power of the Lunar Lancer.  Increases damage done by 15%.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Chance during combat to transform and receive some of the power of the Lunar Lancer.  Increases damage done by 20%.

• Neon Ninja Subclass “Assassinate”
- 35,000 Power Rank: Chance to deal 400% bonus damage to enemies with less than 20% health.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Chance to deal 550% bonus damage to enemies with less than 20% health.

• Pirate Captain Subclass “Naval Gunfire”
- 35,000 Power Rank: Damaging an enemy has a 30% chance to call a cannon ball cannonbally. The area of effect is increased.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Damaging an enemy has a 35% chance to call a cannon ball fcannonball. The area of effect is increased.

• Shadow Hunter Subclass “Searing Light”
- 35,000 Power Rank: Magic attacks can activate Searing Light, a damage over time effect that deals 30% damage every 0.1 second for 3 seconds.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Magic attacks can activate Searing Light, a damage over time effect that deals 40% damage every 0.1 second for 3 seconds.

• Revenant Subclass “Hatred of the Oathbound”
- 35,000 Power Rank: Successful attacks return 6% health.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Successful attacks return 8% health.

• Tomb Raiser Subclass “Corpse Run”
- 35,000 Power Rank: Fallen enemies have a chance to spawn a random minion.  Increased chance to spawn Grave Goliaths.  Reduced cooldown.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Fallen enemies have a chance to spawn a random minion.  Increased chance to spawn Grave Goliaths.  Reduced cooldown.

• Vanguardian Subclass “Up and Away”
- 35,000 Power Rank: Gain the Vanguardian’s Touchdown passive.  While gliding become supercharged and create a shockwave in front of your landing destination, dealing 600% damage.
- 40,000 Power Rank: Gain the Vanguardian’s Touchdown passive.  While gliding become supercharged and create a shockwave in front of your landing destination, dealing 800% damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/1f4db9e4ff55899bf279d5cd8ae896973072f457.png[/img]
• Crystal Gem Converters can be found on the Gems tab for 1,500 credits or 15,000 cubits. (Please note that the art for this is still placeholder - a it is currently cosplaying as a Re-Gemerator.)

• 3 Solarion Packs are available: 
- Solarion Spark Pack – unlocks the Solarion class along with the Floral Fowler costume and the Port A. Bella ally for 1,500 credits.
- Solarion Ember Pack – unlocks the Solarion class along with the Fanatical Phoenix costume, the Disarmed Airmine ally, the Giant Ashen Crawler Larva mount, the Unnatural Devices Ominous Omnibus Legendary Tome and 50 Sund,ercharge Crystals for 3,500 credits.
- Solarion Flare Pack – unlocks the Solarion class along with the DJ Dub Sol costume, the Phoemini ally,  the Complacent Ashen Devourer mount, the Fiery Feathers wings (which fly unaffected in Sundered Uplands), the Sundercharge Crystal Compendium Legendary Tome, the Ashen Sporeling Normal Tome, and 50 Sundercharge Crystals for 5,000 credits

• Greater Sundered Uplands Caches have been added to the More tab of the store.  These caches can contain materials from Sundered Uplands, including harvestable materials, Phoenix Motes, Sundercharge Crystals, Sunder-Ark Cache Keys, and (rarely) tradable versions of some of the allies, mounts, and wings otherwise found on the Sundered Uplands Workbench.

• The store should now consistently hide products the player already owns on the Deals tab.

• Re-Gemerators have now been removed from the store, since the are no longer required to remove equipped gems.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/aade4cb46072157b82fda900d4c37c94ff5d856b.png[/img]
• Raymon the Ever-Puffed is a new Legendary Dragon and can be acquired through the dragon effigy or crafting egg fragments. Pffered Dragon Egg Fragments found by defeating 1-Star and 3-Star dungeons in Candoria.

• Completing a 5 Star dungeon can now give more than a single reward tier.  In other words, completing a Gold reward level while having Silver available will reward Gold, Silver, and Bronze claims.

• Paragon Level Leaderboards have been added.  These contests will rotate weekly and reward players with the most paragon levels gained for a specific class that week.

• Many Hidden Effects have been adjusted to apply in Discovery mode in Delves, although they will not apply inside Geode Caves.

• Removing equipped gems no longer requires Re-Gemerators.  Re-Gemerators can now be deconstructed in to Gem Bointo Boxes.

• Completing the Diamond Badge: Leviathan Slain now awards an Enshadowed Tendril Torch.  This will retroactively be given on login to players who have completed the badge.

• Updated some of the ore found in Geode Caves to properly glow.

• The Shadow Hunter’s Shadowmark should no longer erroneously apply to harmless NPCs like those appearing on the Featured Items Workbench.

• Cave milk should now properly grant energy regeneration to all classes in Geode Caves.

• Cave milk should now properly grant energy regeneration to all classes except Pirate Captain and Lunar Lancer in Delves.  Cave milk does not grant energy regeneration for Pirate Captain and Lunar Lancer since they do not normally regenerate energy over time.

• Fixed an issue with the Critter Bomb Secondary Style where the VFX was not being updated.

• Gems and equipment below Crystal rarity now default to being loot collectable.
collectiblel now open the Gem UI when right-clicking from the inventory.

• Fixed an issue where hairstyle icons would not load when the player was headless but previewing the appearance of another head style.

• The ignore list will now properly continue to prevent messages after a player uses a Name Changer.

• Fixed an issue where players on low-level inasses might not see their health regenerate.

• Moved the recipe for the Shadow-Stitched Carpet to the Winter category and added it to Super Recipe Stashes.

• Fixed an issue that could make some icons turn invisible in build mode for Dino Tamers.

• The /exportmetrics command now also exports Stability.

• Classes that were previously missing audio for footstps havefootstepsrestored.

• Spikewalker Trophies can now stack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/2688b39e74ad9759174b29f8a1381234a317a0c2.gif[/img]

See you in the game,
Your Trove Team

notes.title: 5 ways to get ready for our upcoming Sunrise Update!
notes.notes:
On June 28, our brand new Sunrise update will go live on PC, bringing you the [b]new Solarion class[/b], a brand [b]new biome[/b] called Sundered Uplands, the arrival of [b]Ultimate Bosses[/b] in 5-Star Dungeons and much more! 

Have a look at our trailer: 

[previewyoutube=fQ43VrphcJY;full][/previewyoutube]

Such an exciting time! But wait, maybe you are not ready just yet? No worries! You have some time ahead of you and let us help you with [b]5 ways to make sure YOU will be prepared for Sunrise[/b]. 

[olist]
[*] Gather some Gem Dusts by doing some dungeons and quests, it may come very handy with the newest Gems arriving in the next update, and we never have too much! 
[*] Save your Dragon Coins, new dragons are coming soon, and you may want to keep some in stock to unlock your new favorite dragon. 
[*] Prepare some equipment to make your future Solarion tougher and stronger, you can already get some on the side so when the time comes, you are already one step ahead! 
[*] Tell your friends! It is coming very soon, and you want to make sure everyone is ready for the D-Day, gather your group and even prepare together before the big day 😊 
[*] Hydrate and feed yourself, take care of yourself, go for some walks, stretch a bit! A healthy mind in a healthy body will make Sunrise update even better! 
[/olist]

Many challenges and dangers will await you Trovian, it is important to be prepared for all kinds of monsters and to make sure you are ready to overcome all your enemies. 

Alone or in a group, make sure you are ready to fight but do not worry you will not be alone as [b]your Phoenix will always watch you[/b]! 

[b]Trove’s Sunrise update will be available for free on PC on June 28, 2022.[/b]

Best regards, 
Your Trove team.

notes.title: Event – Grovin' and Trovin'
notes.notes:
Trovians! 

In honor of the [b]#WorldEnvironmentDay[/b] that happened on the 5th of June, we have a very special event planned for all of you – on all platforms! 

From the [b]8th of June until the 5th of July, 00:00 UTC[/b], all players on all platforms will have one goal: Make Trove greener! Yes! 

Planting trees will be your task and many benefits come from it. The world of Trove will become greener and safer, a special ally could be yours and... if together we reach [b]1.000.000 trees planted in-game[/b]; a special exclusive mount will be given to all players! 

It’s time to grow the largest forest in Trove with your friends! 

To plant trees in your club world or elsewhere, you will need Tree Saplings, you can get them through dungeons as well as our [b]Twitch Drops[/b]! Yes, Twitch Drops! Have a look at what we got for you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/e4329224bdabe24633b3ec8daf88e8af685bcf86.png[/img]

If you are a streamer, or a fan of Trove streams, you should keep an eye on the platform, because for this occasion, we will have some amazing Twitch Drops available during the event! 

Have a look at what we got for you! 

Every day, you will get [b]1 Chaos Chest[/b] for watching 30 minutes of a Trove stream! 

During the entire duration of our event, you will be able to get the following items – once per account: 

[b]10x Tree Saplings[/b] for watching 1 hour of stream, to help you out grow your own forest! 
[b]1x Streamer Dream 1[/b] for watching 2 hours in total. 
[b]1x Streamer Dream 2[/b] for watching 3 hours in total. 
[b]1x Streamer Dream 3[/b] for watching 4 hours in total. 
[b]1x Dev Dream[/b] for watching 5 hours in total. 
[b]10x Tree Saplings[/b] for watching 6 hours in total. 
[b]1x Hyper Tree Friend[/b], a unique exclusive ally just for our Grovin’ and Trovin’ event for watching 7 hours of stream. 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/DV5msgfcyS99qTi6HJ/giphy.gif[/img]

It is time to raise awareness for [b]#WorldEnvironmentDay[/b], it is now or never so watch a stream and tell a friend! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/2341a9d44f7117f8fdfc95e8c16596a823e94b55.png[/img]

To recap, through this entire event, you will have the possibility to raise awareness and make a difference in the world of Trove, but it is also a wonderful opportunity to tell everyone that it also affects our world and planet Earth. 

It is time to get in-game Trovian, plant your trees, and together let’s reach 1.000.000 trees planted in-game which will provide the[b] exclusive Sapling Sower mount[/b] to all the players, on all platforms! 

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Srif5KcTVmfonCEXo4/giphy.gif[/img]

So, start doing dungeons to get some Tree Saplings and do not forget to watch your favorite streamers on Twitch to get some amazing rewards, it is your time to shine and to make Trove greener! 

Have fun Trovians, 
Your Trove Team!

notes.title: Fae VS Undead
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/f33368224d7fd6d6cba17d5cc8d7f7b08e33a784.jpg[/img]

Dear Trovians,

September always comes with a conflict in Trove. Last year, our Pirates fought against the Ninjas. Thankfully, this year, the waters and the neon skies are peaceful. It’s a shame that the same can’t be said for the underground. New tombs have been discovered underneath the Fae Forest and Cursed Vale and it has triggered a war between the Wild Fae and the Undead!

The Undead Envoy, Skullerd, and the Fae Prince, Fabio Fae La Fearso, are waiting for you in the hub hoping that you can help them. Choose a side (or play both) and venture into the all new tombs to defeat enemies and farm Marks of Honor that can be used to craft many new rewards, like tomb Terraformers and an all new block type: Target Dummies!

Don't forget to explore the tombs to the last corner, because maybe there are treasures hiding there!

The Fae VS Undead Event begins September 14, 2021 at 11:00 UTC/13:00 CEST/4:00 PST/6:00 CST and ends September 28, 2021 at 11:00 UTC/13:00 CEST/4:00 PST/6:00 CST.

Do not hesitate to visit the FAQ of the event [url=http://forums.trovegame.com/showthread.php?149143-FAQ-Fae-VS-Undead]>>> HERE <<<[/url].

And because good habits should not be changed, the special packs from last year's event as well as this year's new pack are available in our in-game store for the duration of the event: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/2bdfd3ce98ce62d092d5fc55d5d23c2ad13365ac.png[/img]
[b]Pirate's Pack of Ninja Treasures
Brew Crew[/b]

Quick, adventurers! Go and get rid of them in order to restore peace and end this war once and for all - all while earning tons of rewards!

Good luck to everyone !

Best wishes,
Your Trove Team!

notes.title: Depth Stepper in Trove!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/e962c7a0a267a91b9b12546e22ff0088d9e46aad.jpg[/img]

Just in time as the new school year begins, our Trove developers have prepared many tweaks, bug fixes and even new features for us!

Have you always dreamed of being able to select the BOSS or BIOME Delve that interests you most? Or a specific depth? This wish now comes true - with our "Depth Stepper" update.
Discover a whole new style of Delve gateways - the Depth Steppers - which will allow you to navigate to specific biome or boss Delves while being able to select the depth!

You will also find new Glowing Crystalline Caches, containing Freerange Electrolytic Crystals as well as (rarely) Depth Stepper Gateways, 4 new allies, 1 new mount and 2 new banner style recipes.

Discover many other changes and fixes - such as ranking contests where you will have the chance to win the prize of the "Deepest Public Delve" contest - each week featuring a different character class!

Get ready to dive deep into this update! Log in and have fun diving in Trove!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/6b24382b7075ae566a18d1c03fd810b7714187e0.jpg[/img]

Summer is starting to show the tip of its nose while the sun brightens our days and warms our hearts.
Soon we will be celebrating the longest day of the year which marks the official start of summer!

This celebration of the summer solstice is accompanied by the music festival! We'll be hearing the sounds of music everywhere, encouraging us to dance, sing and celebrate this special day for musicians all around the world.

Therefore, why shouldn't we celebrate it in Trove as well? Our little musician - with his elegant movements - makes his debut just in time for this occasion. His powerful songs will mesmerize us and make us even stronger during our various adventures!

Let's welcome our new character class - the BARD - to our "Trove - Tune Up" update. Check out this update's overview, including the Bard, [url=http://forums.trovegame.com/showthread.php?148297-PC-Tune-Up!-June-15-2021]>>> HERE <<<[/url].

Discover this new, very musical, fast and agile class, which will be of great help to its allies during combat thanks to his songs, and which will defeat its enemies while making the strings of its lute vibrate. Show us your very own Bard and make music while playing Trove to earn awesome rewards [url=http://forums.trovegame.com/showthread.php?148318-Show-your-Bard!]>>> HERE <<<[/url].

In addition, there is much more to discover! Check out the newest additions to our in-game store [url=http://forums.trovegame.com/showthread.php?148294-A-melodical-Avalanche-of-new-Features-in-Trove!]>>> HERE <<<[/url]. There is something for everybody!

These new features will only be available on PC at first, but dear console players, don't worry, they will be coming to you too!

notes.title: Prepare for the upcoming Bard class with Twitch Drops!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/ac3f082335bdb561db7339421cf89cb38c091787.png[/img]

Dear Trovians,
We are glad to announce the introduction of Twitch Drops for Trove! In anticipation of the brand new upcoming Bard class, Twitch Drops will be available for Trove - [b]starting June 10, 2021[/b].

Prepare yourself for the adventure of discovering the new class by watching your favorite streamers play Trove on Twitch and get rewards for YOUR account. The more you watch, the more you will receive!


[u][b]What?[/b][/u]
By watching your favorite streamers play Trove on Twitch, you will be able to receive the following rewards:

[u]Daily watching reward:[/u]
Watch Trove for 30 minutes each dayand receive [b]five Chaos Chests[/b]!

[u]Total event rewards:[/u]
Watch Trove for 15 minutes and receive [b]one Chaos Chest*[/b].
Watch Trove for 30 minutes and receive [b]one Streamer Dream 1*[/b].
Watch Trove for 45 minutes and receive [b]one Streamer Dream 2*[/b].
Watch Trove for 60 minutes and receive [b]one Streamer Dream 3*[/b].
Watch Trove for 75 minutes and receive [b]one Dev Dream*[/b].
Watch Trove for 90 minutes and receive [b]one Golden Chaos Chest*[/b].
Watch Trove for 105 minutes and receive [b]one 1-Day-Patron-Pass*[/b].
Watch Trove for 2 hours and receive [b]thirty Dragon Coins*[/b].
Watch Trove for 3 hours total and receive [b]the Cute-Topped Carrot*[/b].
Watch Trove for 4 hours total and receive [b]the Gold Companion Egg*[/b].
Watch Trove for 6 hours total and receive [b]the Infini Frigate and Infineon Insignia Sail*[/b].
Watch Trove for 8 hours total and receive [b]the Chronomancer Costume*[/b]
Watch Trove for 12 hours total and receive [b]the Aegis Override Pack*[/b].

[i]*Reward is limited to one per account.[/i]

[u][b]How?[/b][/u]
To take advantage of Twitch Drops, properly link your Glyph and Twitch accounts. You can find all the information on how to do this by clicking [url=https://www.trionworlds.com/trove/en/game/twitch-drops/]>>> here <<<[/url]!
Once you’ve successfully linked your accounts, watch any Trove stream that has drops enabled during the event period to receive the rewards listed above, based on your watch time.

Watch your favorite streamers play and enjoy Trove, prepare yourself for the new Bard class and get rewarded for it now [b]until July 8, 2021[/b]!

Best wishes,
Your Trove team!

notes.title: Crack the Court - March 23rd, 2021
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/ec1d6135092bdbc403ef1ebc3de56b7a9d589039.jpg[/img]

Dear Trovians,

The developers of Trove have prepared many small adjustments and even some new features for the end of the month!

Discover a new biome in the delves. The Crack the Court biome awaits you with new mounts, new allies, new banner styles and new mementos.

You will also be able to discover many other adjustments and fixes in the delves as well as a new configuration for User Interface Mods!

The Leviathans also have surprises in store for travelers on the surface of the Geode.

Get ready to explore the wonderful content of this update! Log in and #StaySafe while playing Trove!


The following patch notes are PC only. Here's an overview of today's update:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/b8236dd2d043f7d96a7a360815cfc711e77f79a3.png[/img]
[list]
[*] A new biome has been added to delves!
[*] Called Crack the Court, this biome is based on the Fae Wilds biome.
[*] 2 new mounts, 3 new allies, 3 new banner styles, and 10 new mementos can be found in this biome.
[*] A “spiderboss” matchmaker is initially available for a limited purchase from the delve hub merchant.
[*] ”Spiderboss,” “King,” and “Queen” matchmakers are available as rare drops from the delve lockbox.
[*] Once the mementos for these bosses are unlocked, these matchmakers can be crafted on Fae Fridays (all Fridays are Fae Fridays) under the “Daily Memento Gateways” section of the Delve Workbench.
[*] Minibosses – a new Delve objective type, pitting Trovians against a single, beefed-up enemy – can appear exclusively (for now) in the Crash the Court biome.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/dcee90937eaa855aad36687ad9dd433a90de69ec.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Hovercycles have been added as new mounts from Leviathans.
[*] Each Geode Topside Leviathan drops one of the hovercycle recipes. These recipes are not available from Leviathans in delves.
[*] Crafting a hovercycle requires a weekly torch from that Leviathan along with other materials.
[*] Hovercycles may also act as ships when used in water.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/e3d4fc98b0334712c83ddd93724b04bf83ee142b.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Mods can now have configurations for ui changes by adding a config file with the mods name(MyMod.cfg) to your Trove appdata folder. On PC it is located here C:\Users[localUser]\AppData\Roaming\Trove\ModCfgs
[*] Inside the configuration file, set specific ui's by creating a section like and adding key pair values to it like so. All values are treated as strings.
[*] [chat.swf]
[*] ValueA = Hello
[*] ValueB = True
[*] The actionscript can listen to config changes by defining a new function and registering it with interface callback in configUI.
[*] ExternalInterface.addCallback("loadModConfiguration", onLoadModConfiguration);
[/list]
Then define the function onLoadModConfiguration like so
private function onLoadModConfiguration(key:String, value:String):void
{
//code
}
[list]
[*] That will be called once for every config value you have listed in the section that relates to this .swf.
[*] Saving config or changing config of another UI will require making an extermal interface call from the code:
[*] ExternalInterface.call("UIComponent.OnSaveConfig", [ui.swf], [key], [value]);
[*] The three arguments after the function name are for changing the value of another ui or refreshing the current one. If the UI or Key is empty the call will fail.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/36c6ce4ca2ad7299145809e789bb0413f79eebc0.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Mastery has been extended.
[*] Increased the darkness of delves around depth 170 and deeper.
[*] Mementos have their appearances updated. Daily Memento Gateways have had their item images updated to match.
[*] /club list should no longer crash the client.
[*] Collection tooltips will no longer fly off the top of the screen at odd window sizes.
[*] Added several new deltaliths to delves: Flak Bombardment, Spike Covered, and Chain Death.
[*] It should no longer be possible to open shadow tower or leviathan boss Gateways at a depth below which they can appear.
[*] Shadow tower boss Gateways now have a minimum depth of 35, but can start deeper depending on queued players.
[*] Leviathan boss Gateways now have a minimum depth of 85, but can start deeper depending on queued players.
[*] Delves with crystal gathering objectives now require less crystals.
[*] Music in delves is now more varied.
[*] Added several new rooms to delves.
[*] Some impassible walls have been broken down in delves.
[*] Fixed some lighting issues that could appear in delves.
[*] The Last Taxi mount can no longer be used in delves.
[*] Chaos chest rewards should consistently allow themselves to be deconstructed for chaos cores.
[*] Some monster models have been updated to refer to correct pieces.
[*] Some items will now be automatically looted that previously required being picked up.
[*] Fixed the description for the Harbinger of Heck costume for the Pirate Captain.
[*] Removed mastery from some mounts and allies that should not be available yet.
[*] Corrected typo in collections, item that was listed as "Captains Quarry" has been corrected to "Captain's Quarry".
[/list]


Thank you for your patience and your understanding.

Have fun in Trove!

Best regards,
Your Trove Team!

notes.title: Trove combines cave exploration and battle royale bombs in a new free expansion
notes.notes:
This is a sponsored post courtesy of Trion Worlds.

We don't know when you last checked in with Trove, the fully destructible action MMO. But like any one of its maps, it's been changing and evolving, reshaped by its developers and players over the three years it's been on Steam.

Recent adventures have taken in neon-lit megacities, while creative Trovians have made everything from castles in the sky to bacon swords. And if the havoc of the multiverse gets too dizzying, you can always plonk down your Cornerstone - the home you build yourself and plant in any world you happen to be visiting. An oasis of calm amid the cube-powered madness.

Like your games freeform, do you? Try one of the best sandbox games on PC.

That's just as well, since Trove's new Geode expansion takes the game into brave new areas of game design it's never attempted before. At one end you've got a planet to explore where violence, for the first time, isn't the answer. And at the other you've got Bomber Royale, Trove's most competitive and explosive mode yet.

notes.title: Let's Celebrate 20 Years of gamigo!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8957071/b7c08f9699c09f8d0b318badb7880d62dd85fc64.jpg[/img]

gamigo is turning 20 years old! 20 years of memories, ups and downs, friendships, soulmates, enemies and kinship. We would like to share our happiness with you all in the form of events, challenges, social media and forum activities, and much more! There will be tons of chances to win some amazing prizes, such as gaming devices, hoodies and thousands of Euros of in-game currencies across our dozens of games!

Since this is the perfect opportunity to show you all how much you mean to us, we will also have a very special tiered reward system with special bundles. Every time we hit a goal you will be rewarded for your favorite games. Our communities make us the amazing gaming company we are today, we never could have done any of it without you! You all make this a gaming family; you are the heart and soul of this 20th anniversary celebration. Thank you!


[b][u]All that is happening:[/u][/b]

[i][u]Anniversary Points – Win cool stuff![/u][/i]
You can win Anniversary points in weekly challenges and screen shots event and via voucher codes!

[i][u]Challenges[/u][/i]
Compete in server challenges and be the best of your game to win anniversary points. The first one has already started, [url=http://forums.trovegame.com/showthread.php?145725-20-Years-of-gamigo-The-First-Challenge-The-Invitations]check it out here[/url].

[i][u]Screenshots[/u][/i]
Mimic the posted screen shot and win anniversary points. The first one has already started, [url=http://forums.trovegame.com/showthread.php?145726-Screenshot-Challenge-Recipe-1-The-Perfect-Place]check it out here[/url].

[u][i]Vouchers[/i][/u]
Watch in-game, social media pages, Discord chats, and forums for surprise vouchers codes. There is no rhyme nor reason to when or where they will pop-up. They will only pop-up in one location at a time, so keep your eyes peeled for them. The first 10 players to redeem the voucher will earn 500 Anniversary Points, the small gift is yours to keep of course! Be quick and don’t miss out.

[u][i]What can I win?[/i][/u]
Gather the most anniversary points to rank in the leaderboard for your game. If you manage to stay on the leaderboard by the time the event is fully finished, you will receive a cool prize and be entered into a raffle for a Mouse and Keyboard bundle as well as game cash for your game.

Want to keep an eye on your points? Then watch the Leaderboard here: [url=https://20anniversary.gamigo.com/]https://20anniversary.gamigo.com[/url]

[i][u]Special Bundles with a kick![/u][/i]
Special Shop Bundles have been created and each purchase helps progress the bar towards a goal to earn cool prizes or events that can be received and enjoyed by everyone!

Check out the Prepared Adventure's Pack, Sporty Stack, and Dressy Dragon Pack in the game store!

Special bundle purchases from all games will help move the bar.


These are the fun things you can unlock:

Level 1
1 Greater Geodian Topside Cache
5 Dragon Coins

Level 2
2 Greater Neon Caches
3 Chaos Chests

Level 3
100 Nitro-Glitterine
5 Greater Crystal Caches

Level 4
1 Golden Chaos Chest
1 Trove of Wonders Chest


View the progress of the bundle tiers anytime on the Anniversary Website! [url=https://20anniversary.gamigo.com/]https://20anniversary.gamigo.com[/url]

[u][i]Share your moments[/i][/u]
Share with us your most memorable moment from any gamigo game for the past 20 years
OR
Wish us a happy birthday!


Wanna know how, check out the website! [url=https://20th.gamigo.net/en/shareyourmoment.html]https://20th.gamigo.net/en/shareyourmoment.html[/url]

[b][u]Important Information:[/u][/b]
[i][u]Winners[/u][/i]
Winners will be published at the end of the month when all events have ended, and everything tallied. We appreciate your patience and understanding while we take the time to ensure everything is counted properly before we announce the winner.

[i][u]Anniversary Point Ranking and Bundle Progression[/u][/i]
The Anniversary Point rankings and Special Bundle progression bar will not be auto updated, they will be updated once per normal workday to reflect the goings on from the past hours. We do not have an exact time this will happen, nor do we guarantee it will happen over the weekend. Only the top 50 users on the rankings will be visible, and rankings will be split per game. All point totals for all users, even those not in the top 50, will still be saved.

[i][u]Rankings[/u][/i]
Names in the rankings will be displayed with asterisks blocking all except the first and last letter of the ranked party’s name (for example O****N instead of ORION). There will be a voucher item available to anyone who wants/agrees to have their full name displayed in the ranking on the anniversary. By using the voucher item, you will be agreeing to have your full character name available to everyone who views the page. Voucher: [b]SHOWYOURNAME20TROVE[/b]
The name that will be displayed in the ranking, will be the name of the first character you login on you account, after redeeming the SHOWYOURNAME20TROVE voucher.

notes.title: Trove is Going Green!
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce that the Gardening 2.0 update is now in season, and that means that Gardening is bigger and better than ever. With new ways to craft, new plants to harvest, and new food to eat… It’s time to dig in! 

We’ve turned Gardening up to 300, granting the rank of Horticulturist. There are also two new types of plants available: Vegetable Plants and Alchemy Plants.  Alchemy Plants give you more of the resources you need, while Vegetable Plants give you vegetables to help you grow big and strong. 

Eat your veggies! Wash your vegetables at the Vegetable Sink, then equip them in the Food slot to get a buff!  This buff will go away over time, so make sure you keep the food coming. 

How does your garden grow? All new Vegetable and Alchemy plants require watering and time before they can be harvested!  Grab a Watering Can and get to sprinkling. 

Reap all kinds of new rewards with Gardening: 

[list]
[*] Bobble Pods are a fun new kind of pinata – throw them and watch them grow, then beat them up with some friends to get a shot at the Ridable Bobble Pod, a new immobile mount.  Live out your best grocery store ride fantasies! 
[*] Grow Ally Habitats together with your club – get the rare ally and watch the whole server tromp through your club! 
[*] Kahramet, Warden of the Fields has also been attracted to Trove by the new growth – take flight on her flowery wings! 
[*] New badges for Harvesting, Watering Plants, and Composting, each with their own rewards! 
[/list]

Get all the juicy details on this Gardening update by reading our [url=http://forums.trovegame.com/showthread.php?139247-Trove-Going-Green!-May-28-2019&_ga=2.170330720.1148579016.1559062204-81283297.1526483799]patch notes[/url].

Don’t be a late bloomer – go start your own garden today!

notes.title: St. Qubeslick 2019 Is Here!
notes.notes:

St. Qubeslick 2019 may be here for a short period of time, but stockpile enough Lucky Clovers and fortune will ever be in your favor.
