notes.title: Mantle of Power Preview – Power Up your Adventures!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/04/MantleOfPowerBlog.jpg[/IMG]

The Mantle of Power expansion brings new worlds to explore, tougher foes to fight, and brand new paths to power! With 10 new character levels, 4 new types of elemental Adventure Worlds, 3 new Uber world difficulties, and epic Empowered class abilities, Trove is taking the MMO to new heights!

[I]Empowered Gems[/I]
By socketing an Empowered Gem, every class in Trove will be able to modify their abilities to allow greater flexibility in any situation. Here are just a few of the upcoming class skills:

The Gunslinger’s “Overcharged” Empowered Gem makes every shot fired from Run And Gun into a fully charged shot. Attack speed is lowered, but the Gunslinger a mobile and heavy duty slugger of charged destruction.

The Neon Ninja’s “Heuristic Hackstar” Empowered Gem replaces the normal shuriken with a massive buzzsaw that passes through enemies, damaging every enemy in its path and applying Stasis Blade.

The Shadow Hunter’s “Shadow Blitz” Empowered Gem amplifies basic attacks into a stream of arrows—a channeled attack that costs energy, and also causes any shadowmarked enemy hit to damage nearby enemies.

There are also several Universal Empowered Gems, which are usable by any class, such as:

The “Pyrodisc” Empowered gem, which can erupt into a flaming disc of damage around you whenever you defeat an enemy.

The “Mired Mojo” Empowered gem, which may trigger any time you deal damage with any power, and will spawn a ring of snaring projectiles that will reduce enemy movement speed.

[I]Gem Overview[/I]
The Gem system is one of the many ways you’ll be able to power up this expansion and it’s important to have an understanding of how this system works.

A Gem tab is being added to your character sheet (C) where you’ll add Gems and Empowered Gems to your classes. Each class has its own Gem sockets meaning you can use the Gems that suit each class best.

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/04/gemUI.png[/IMG]

When you reach character level 10 you’ll unlock your first set of three Gem slots, with others following at level 18, 24, and 28. Empowered Gem sockets unlock at character levels 21, 26, and 30. Gems add stats and Power Rank, and Empowered Gems further add additional gameplay effects.

While Gems themselves are exclusively picked up during your adventures in game, there are several ways to pick up Gem-related items:

[LIST=1]
[*]Play Trove! While Gems occasionally drop from any Uber world, you can sail the Drowned World to get Water Gems, soar through the Cursed Skylands for Air Gems, or sail through the lava in the Igneous Islands for Fire Gems. Portals to these elemental adventure worlds can be found on the new Adventure Tower in the Hub once the Mantle of Power goes live.
[*]Buy Gem Booster Boxes from the Trove Store. These Booster Boxes can contain Gem Dust, a variety of Boosters (explained below), and will rarely contain an Empowered Gem Box. These boxes can be purchased for Credits or Cubits (in game currency earned by playing Trove).
[*]Exchanging Lunar Souls for Empowered Gem Boxes from the Shadow Market vendor in the Shadow Tower.
[/LIST]

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/04/drowned-adventure-portal.png[/IMG]

[I]How to use Gems[/I]
When you’ve found a Gem that fits your lust for power, just drag it to an open socket on the Gem tab of your character sheet to start reaping the benefits. Only an Empowered Gem will fit in an Empowered Gem socket and only regular Gems will fit in regular Gem sockets. Water Gems can only be socketed in the blue sockets, Air in yellow, and Fire in red.

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/04/socket-gem-message.png[/IMG]

Gems can also be deconstructed in the Loot Collector to create Gem Dust. Collect as much Gem Dust as possible because you’ll use it to level up your Gems, which is key to improving your stats and Power Rank.

You’ll be able to drag a new Gem over a placed Gem to replace it, but this process will destroy the original Gem. To keep a previously placed Gem you can drag it from the Gem menu back to your inventory. Unscoketing like this will cost some Flux but will leave the Gem available to be used again later. Slot wisely!

Levelling Up and Boosters
 If you want to kick things up to the next level you can level up your Gems to add even more power! To level up a Gem just right-click it (which will place it in the Level Up area of the Gems tab) and click the Level Up button.

When levelling your standard Gems you’ll notice that they can be easily upgraded to higher levels. With late game Gems you’ll find a few different outcomes may happen when trying to level up:

[LIST=1]
[*]Level Up! This means your Gem will increase in level by one, granting new stats and Power Rank. Upgrading is especially powerful at levels 5, 10, and 15. Watch for big leaps in power at these points, and even entirely new stats being discovered in your Gems.
[*]Cracked. When a Gem becomes Cracked it still provides all the stat and Power Rank benefits it did, but it cannot be further levelled until repaired with a Re-Gemerator (sold for Cubits in the Store).
[*]Failure. If this happens the materials used in the upgrade process will be lost.
[*]Double Level Up! When this happens your Gem’s level will increase two levels, granting two levels worth of stat and Power Rank gains. This is living the dream as the Gem Dust costs can get expensive at higher levels so two for one is huge!
[/LIST]

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/04/levelup.png[/IMG]

[I]Better and Better Gems[/I]
In Uber-1 adventure worlds, you’ll typically find Common Gems dropping, which can be levelled up to level 3. Need more power? No problem. Just go to Uber-2, where you’ll find more Uncommon Gems, which can be levelled to 5. The higher the world, the better the Gems, which ultimately means more stats and Power Rank.

You’ll also notice that some Gems have stars under their icon in your inventory. These are a quick indicators to tell you roughly how good each Gem is. Gems have variable properties, and some stats may be better for your playstyle. Levelling a Gem will sometimes add a star, but this is simply a reflection of the general usefulness; check the stats and the Power Rank to make sure this is the Gem for you.

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/04/gem-power-rank.png[/IMG]

When levelling a Gem, turn the tide in your favor by using a variety of Boosters. There are four Boosters available. Using any boost will remove the risk of a Gem becoming Cracked for that Level Up attempt, and also affect the chances of a Level Up or Double Level Up happening.

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/04/booster.png[/IMG]

[I]Pre-order a Mantle of Power Edition Bundle[/I]
[URL=http://store.steampowered.com/app/304050/]Purchase any of our Mantle of Power Edition packs[/URL] and receive a collection of Gem Dust, Boosters, Empowered Gem Boxes, and head start access beginning on April 19th! Make your purchase by April 25th and save 25% off the regular price!

On April 26th the Mantle of Power expansion goes live for everyone! Take your adventures to the next level with Trove’s first expansion, the Mantle of Power!

notes.title: Extra Life Bundle – Support Children’s Hospitals!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/04/ExtraLife.jpg[/IMG]

Every year our amazing players step up and help Trion Worlds raise money for a tremendous cause: [url=http://www.extra-life.org/]Extra Life,[/url] a Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals fundraising program! We can’t begin to thank you enough for all of your support. You really help us help the kids!

To show our appreciation for those who helped us raise funds and awareness for Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals, we’re happy to announce the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/462920]Extra Life Bundle[/url]! This brand new pack contains a huge collection of goodies designed by Kumar “Atronos” Daryanani in collaboration with our supporters.

The [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/462920]Extra Life Bundle[/url] includes all of these brand new additions to Trove:

6 Allies – Griffon, Corgi, Panda, Tree Frog, Dragonfly, and Paper Crane
4 Mounts – Platypus, Guinness, Rowdy (Fasti’s Bulldog), and Centaur
12 Equipment Styles – 5 helmet styles, 3 hat styles, 1 mask style, 2 spear styles, 1 pistol style
2 Dragon Eggs – Use your Dragon Souls to unlock Yorinn the Dusk Shadow and Erel the Ironbolt!

With your generous support, Extra Life has raised more than 22 million dollars to help care for sick and injured kids around in the U.S. and Canada – and that’s just the beginning! 

Remember to [URL=http://www.extra-life.org/index.cfm?fuseaction=donorDrive.team&teamID=27860]sign up for Team Trion this year[/URL] and help us drive to $100,000+ on our 24-hour livestream, November 5th, 2016!

[I]Trion Worlds, Inc. will donate 50% from the sale of each new Trove Extra Life Pack (up to a maximum amount of US$20,000) to Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals. Donations will be made for all eligible packs sold worldwide (excluding South Carolina, Alabama, Illinois, and Massachusetts) between 12:00 AM PDT, April 5, 2016 through 11:59 pm PDT, April 30, 2016. This contribution is not tax deductible. Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals is a tax exempt 501(c)(3) organization located at 205 West 700 South, Salt Lake City, Utah, 84101.[/I]

Update 1 - We're back online, folks. Thanks!

Hey folks, 

We're going to come offline on Tuesday to release the Extra Life Edition patch. 

Downtime should take approximately 1 hour and will start at [URL=https://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7AM+PDT+April+5+2016]7AM PDT (2PM GMT)[/URL].

Thanks all!

[B]Weekly Events[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Chaos Chest contents have been shuffled! Expand your Manta Ray collection with the newly available Saltwater Taffy Ray! Created by community member FriedSushi!
[*]Battle Experience granted for [B]wins[/B] in the Battle Arena has been doubled for this week!
[*]The amount of time it takes to receive Battle Boxes has been reduced for this week!
[/LIST]

[B]Extra Life 2015 Pack[/B]
The Extra Life 2015 Pack has been added to the store for a limited time! Get your hands on the following awesomeness unlocked on your acct:
[LIST]
[*]Two dragon eggs, used at the Dragon Crucible to unlock new Legendary Dragons. These dragons don't grant passive stats now, but will in the future and the eggs will also eventually be available to everyone.
[*]Duskrider Dragoon - New costume for Lunar Lancer (Plus two styles)
[U]Mounts[/U]
[*]Regular Centaur
[*]Aquilia the Furred - New amphibious platypus mount
[*]Guinness (the dog)
[*]Rowdy (the other dog!)
[U]Allies[/U]
[*]James Joystick
[*]Dr. Qubesly
[*]Radar - lovable dog
[*]Drizzy - lovable(?) dragonfly
[*]Poisonous Perry - Frog (don't love, too poisonous!)
[*]Sandwich - LOVABLE Panda
[*]Corinne - For sure lovable Paper Crane
[*]Skrgle - Pretty lovable!
[U]Styles[/U]
[*]Plus 11 new styles (and one old!) found under the Extra Life category in Styles!
[/LIST]

[B]Battle Arena Maps[/B]
Battle Arena maps have been cycled! Out with the old, in with the new! Check out our awesome new community created Battle Arena maps!
[LIST]
[*]Sky Island - Cubed Reality
[*]Arch - Dylan and Associates
[*]Maze - VoxelBusters
[*]LaserTag - VoxelBusters
[*]Eyeball - Defiant Few
[*]Medieval Bowl - SunLP
[*]Gardens - SunLP
[*]Simple Arches - Denial of Service
[*]Skulls - Edge of Abyss
[*]Cliffs - Edge of Abyss
[*]Golden Arena - Wingzor
[*]Space Battles - KassusSucks
[/LIST]

[B]Misc[/B]

[*]Fixed a bug where duplicate Mastery was granted for unlocked items if the item's name was later changed (vials, in most cases).

[*]Opening up lootboxes will no longer force you to dismount (excluding boxes which are thrown, such as ringcrafting boxes, which will still cause you to plummet to your doom!).
[/LIST]

[B]Mantle of Power Head Start[/B]
Mantle of Power Head Start Editions are available for pre-order at a discounted price in the Trove Store and through Steam!  Not only will you get access to Mantle of Power a week early, but you will also get a variety of goodies to give you a head-start on the new Gem system once it lands in Trove!

notes.title: Double Cubits From Filling The Star Bar!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/03/unboxed.jpg[/IMG]

Greetings Trovians,

This week you'll get double the Cubits for filling up the Star Bar each day in Trove!

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/03/StarBar.png[/IMG]

In addition to being a cool looking piece of the user interface, the Star Bar is also a great way to earn Cubits. Cubits are an in-game currency that is used to buy Dragon Coins, mounts, wings, and more from the Trove Store. After the Mantle of Power expansion is released you’ll also be able to use Cubits in the new Gem system so having some stashed away will be very helpful!

The Star Bar fills up as you complete [URL=http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/game/dungeons-lairs/]Dungeons and Lairs[/URL]. Some offer more progress than others, so take a look at the mission that pops up as you enter a dungeon area. One star areas give progress toward filling the Star Bar while three star dungeons take a bit more effort and give even more progress! Once the Star Bar is full it will pay out a stack of Cubits.

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/03/ThreeStar.png[/IMG]

Free to play accounts will get 500 Cubits for filling the bar each day. [URL=http://store.steampowered.com/app/449670/]Patrons[/URL] will earn 1000 Cubits each day for filling the bar. During special weeks (like this one) these bonuses can be raised even higher (free to play will receive 1,000 Cubits and Patrons receive 2,000 Cubits this week)!

We'll continue to roll out new [URL=http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/?s=trove+unboxed"]Trove Unboxed articles[/URL] and videos to teach you the basics of life as a Trovian, so be sure to stay tuned!

notes.title: Preview - Stellar Gear - Mantle of Power
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/09/launch_blog_header-720x322.jpg[/IMG]

Radiant items have long been the pinnacle of Trove equipment. When the Mantle of Power expansion drops we’re taking gear to a stellar new level!

Take existing five star Radiant gear to a [B]Forge[/B] and upgrade to Stellar quality to unlock its full potential.
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/03/stellar-2.png[/IMG]

If you upgrade a hat to Stellar quality, you’ll also gain the added bonus of unique new auras! Use the [B]Enchanted Forge[/B] to select the aura that suits you.

Roast some marshmallows with the Crown of Flames.
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/03/Fire_Aurua.jpg[/IMG]

Ponder what it all means with the Holy Halo.
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/03/RainbowAura.jpg[/IMG]

Chillax with the Wreath of Rime.
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/03/SnowflakeAura.jpg[/IMG]

Recharge with the Arcing Aureole
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/03/arcing.png[/IMG]

The Mantle of Power will be Trove’s first expansion, but this is just the beginning of an amazing year to come!

notes.title: Follow the Leaderboards!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/03/leaderboards__blog.jpg[/IMG]

Trove Leaderboards have arrived! For those of you with a competitive spirit, you can see where you rank compared to your fellow Trovians.

[img]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/03/mastery1.png[/img]

How do I check the Leaderboards?
[list]
[*]Open the Leaderboard menu by pressing the K key (default).
[*]Click the categories on the left to select what stats you’d like to see.
[*]Select a sub-category like Blocks Destroyed, Fish Caught, or Enemies Killed.
[*]You’ll see your character’s rank denoted by the small character icon.
[*]Click the arrow keys to scroll through the rankings.
[/list]

[img]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/03/blocks.png[/img]

Don’t expect us to stop here, either! These leaderboards will continue to evolve, so new content will be added over time, including our upcoming Contests! Our friends at [url=http://www.mmorpg.com/gamelist.cfm/game/984/feature/10652/Trove-Of-Leaderboards-and-Shadow-Worlds.html]MMORPG.com have more info on Contests[/url] available in their latest article.

Indulge in some friendly competition with the Trove Leaderboards today!

notes.title: Patch - Leader of the Block Edition - 8:30 AM PST (4:30 PM GMT)
notes.notes:
Hey folks!

This morning Trove will go offline to roll out the Leader of the Block patch and to perform a reset on character names for players inactive since August 1st.

The downtime will be longer than usual as we run the name resets on the database. We'll bring the servers down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=8:30+AM+PST+March+8+2016]8:30 AM PST (4:30 PM GMT)[/URL]) and expected down time is 3 hours.

I'll keep this post updated if we come back online early, or need a bit more time. 

[B]Leaderboards are here![/B]

Check out the new leaderboards to see just how awesome you really are! See who has the highest mastery, most blocks destroyed, most enemies killed, and more! Press K (default) to view them!

[B]Events & Sales[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Get yourself ready for the Mantle of Power expansion! All classes are 66% off and adventure experience is boosted by 100%!
[*]The Rename Tag is on sale for 250 credits!
[*]The Chaos Chest has been updated! Try on the all-new Wings of the Pegasus!
[*]The drop rate of chaos coins has increased in the form of a coin which cannot be traded.
[*]Spring Piñatas have replaced Winter Piñatas on the store, spring must be near!
[/LIST]

[B]Costumes[/B]

Remember the Blitz 'N' Glitz  costume pack? Shadow's Eve? To the Nines? They're all back in the rotating deals on the store! Also, check out three new player-designed costumes:
[LIST]
[*]Dub-O-Mancer (Chloromancer) - designed by ExtrysGO!
[*]Time Sage (Ice Sage)- designed by iStinger!
[*]Turtleborn (Dracolyte) - designed by iStinger!
[/LIST]

[B]Paragon Wings[/B]

Paragon Wings have made their way into Trove! These high end (and high class) wings come in three flavors, find them on the Shadowy Market (Blue), the Weaver of Wonders (Green), and on the Battle Broker (Red)!

[B]Battle Arena[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed a bug where multiple players would get the Flag-carrier VFX if they tried to pick up a flag simultaneously.
[*]Minions now have colored shadows to indicate their team.
[*]Lunar Lancers now have 55 movement speed when in Battle Arena matches instead of 70.
[/LIST]

[B]Misc Changes & Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where Fridays bonus was granting 50/100% of shadow shards, rather than 100/200% (for everyone/patron).
[*]Fixed an issue introduced last week which caused the automatic spam filter to malfunction.
[*]Fixed a weird bug where your store could get way, way too many tabs. So many that they'd spill over to the edge of your screen.
[*]Extended the length of time you can be afk before you get kicked.
[*]Added an invite button to the friends list that mimics the behavior of /joinme.
[*]Removed text indications for lootbox karma--the bar works quite well :)
[*]When in Do Not Disturb mode, friend requests will now go directly into your Friends window for you to accept later.
[*]Moving when using a controller will now dismiss windows that keyboard movement would dismiss.
[*]Fixed an issue where controller axis inversion worked in the opposite way it should.
[*]Fixed an issue where moving a controller stick while loading could cause a crash.
[*]Adjusted the wording on the Club Phone.
[*]Fixed an occasional client crash that could occur while exiting the game.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Inactive Name Resets Coming March 7th
notes.notes:
[img]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/10/launch_blog_header-720x3221.jpg[/img]

We’re freeing up names used by inactive characters on [b]March 7th, 2016[/b]! If you’ve long dreamed of being XsklORVAXXZZ36 but that was taken by a player who is inactive, have we got good news for you! If you’re currently XsklORVAXXZZ36 and love it, be sure to sign into Trove by March 7th to keep your sweet name!

Characters that have been inactive since August 1st will need to log into Trove before March 7th in order to keep their names. If an inactive character logs in after the name reset they’ll be prompted to pick a new name at the next sign in. 

Not only that, but [b]everyone[/b] who logs in between now and March 7th will receive 1,500 Cubits and (if you’re Mastery rank 10 or higher) you’ll also receive five free Chaos Chests!

We sent emails last month to anyone who may have a character name reset, but wanted to be sure to give everyone another reminder. Stake a claim on your name in Trove today!

notes.title: Mantle Of Power – New Worlds Order
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/02/islandworld.jpg[/IMG]

Brave new worlds are coming to Trove with the Mantle of Power expansion! Not only will you have access to an additional ten character levels and Gems to customize your abilities but you’ll also be able to adventure to vast new regions with our updated world engine.

Our advanced rendering software will allow us to create world variants that are not possible today. Explore new sky realms with floating lakes connected by cat-walks and lava worlds that house oceans of molten lava dotted by charred isles.

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/03/LavaWorld.jpg[/IMG]

Adventure through sprawling, multi-tiered Neon City worlds with ground and sky levels connected by towering…towers and shadow worlds under constant attack by powerful invaders.

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/03/InvasionWorld.jpg[/IMG]

We’ll be able to mix-and-match the elements from various biomes to create brand new adventure worlds more diverse than anything you’ve ever seen! Here you’ll explore all new dungeons and face off against unique enemies with new fighting styles.

The Mantle of Power expansion is going to change the Trovian landscape forever!

[b]Update 2[/b] - 10:40 AM PST (6:40 PM GMT) - We're back online! Thanks for your patience!

[B]Update 1[/B] - 9:20 AM PST (5:20 PM GMT) - The background systems that are receiving software updates have run longer than anticipated. While I don't have a specific estimate for when we'll be back online just yet, there are just a couple updates left to go, so we're hopeful this will be a short extension. Thanks all!

Hey folks!

Trove will be coming offline on Tuesday to roll out the Winter Is Leaving patch. We're also going to be running some background software updates for our non-database systems which means we'll need a bit more time that normal.

We'll bring the servers down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PST+March+1+2016]7 AM PST (3 PM GMT)[/URL]) and expected down time is 2.5 hours.

I'll keep this post updated if we come back online early, or need a bit more time.

[B]Featured[/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Winter Piñatas[/B] are leaving soon and therefore on sale now! Get them for [B]half off[/B] this week, and any rare loot from them is [B]doubled[/B]!
[*][B]Many-Legged Adventure Boxes[/B] now drop from fallen foes
[*]The Chaos Chest has been updated! Get your hands on the new [B]Rampage Raptor[/B]!
[/LIST]

[B]Game Updates[/B]
[LIST]
[*]All equipment now gives a consistent amount of flux for its rarity (star value no longer matters) and in average is at an amount equal to one star previously. 
[*]Shadow 2+ equipment now deconstructs for less flux, on average.
[*]Added an "Invite" button to the Friends List menu so you can invite friends to your location. 
[*]You can no longer deconstruct [B]Dragon Eggs[/B] or [B]Dragon Coins[/B] 
[*]Loot box karma no longer has a text indicator. 
[*]There is now a lock box callout when a shaper's vision box gives a penta soul.
[*]The [B]Lunar New Year Egg[/B] deal has ended. if you missed out, you can still pick up the Lunar Egg on the Trove Store for 10,000 cubits.
[/LIST]

[B]Lesser Dragon Caches[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Caches give more flux in total with between 300 and 700 at common and 2,500 at uncommon. 
[*]In addition, we've increased the frequency at which they will give a Dragon Coin. Though they are less likely to drop multiple coins at common
[*]At rare Dragon Caches now give 10 coins. 
[*]Challenges now give their 1 no-trade coin for the first level and the next two levels each give 2 Lesser Dragon Caches.
[/LIST]

[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed bug where bosses spawned from Cursed Skulls would sometimes not attack players
[*]Fixed an issue with the Li'l Bae ally that caused it not to grant its bonus. 
[*]Cleaned up some visual problems with some images in the store. 
[*]Fixed potential client crash when using Whisper from the Friends Menu
[*]Bug fix for cubit bar not being doubled for Patrons in all situations on login (though as soon as you zoned, it would) 
[*]Fixed a bug that could result in a player seeing a "Received User Acknowledgement" message but then being unable to fully log in.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Lunar New Year Dragon Is Here!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/02/lunar_dragon.jpg[/IMG]

The Lunar New Year Dragon brood has arrived in Trove and brings with it an all new way to unlock dragons! 

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/02/LunarNewYear.gif[/IMG]

Sign into Trove by March 1st and find the Dormant Egg available for free on the in game store. Once you’ve collected the egg, combine it with Flux, Dragon Coins, and Primordial Flame at the Dragon Crucible in the Hub to unlock Selene, the Celestial Storm!

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/02/selene.png[/IMG]

There are now multiple ways to acquire Dragon Coins:
[LIST]
[*]In the Goods tab of the Trove Store you can buy 5 Dragon Coins at a time for 750 Cubits
[*]Challenges now drop Lesser Dragon Caches that commonly contain Flux, uncommonly contain a few Dragon Coins, and rarely drop tradable Dragon Coins!
[*]Your first completed Challenge of the day will grant 5 Dragon Coins
[*]A bonus Dragon Coin is granted for finishing the final tier of a Challenge
[*]Owners of the legendary Dragon Coin Tome will now receive 25 Dragon Coins each week when it’s triggered
[*]If you have previous dragon caches stored away, have no fear! These have been upgraded to grant 3 Dragon Coins (up from 1) at Common and 20 Dragon Coins (up from 5) at Rare!
[/LIST]

We’ve also added a new item, the Golden Lunar New Year Egg that is available as a bonus item when buying the new $99.99 Lunar Special Credit Pack on the Trove Store. This tradable egg can be used by you, given to a friend, or sold on the Marketplace and immediately hatches Selene, the Celestial Storm when opened!

Greater Dragon Caches are also new to Trove. Found in the Goods tab, these caches commonly contain 10 Dragon Coins, uncommonly drop 50 Dragon Coins, and very rarely drop enough Dragon Souls to complete one of our previous dragons, or a Golden New Year Dragon Egg!

The new look and feel of this gorgeous dragon brood is just a glimpse at the many amazing things on the horizon for Trovians everywhere!

notes.title: Patch - Monkey Business Edition - 2/16/2016 - 7AM PST (3PM GMT)
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/02/LunarNewYear.gif[/IMG]


Hey folks!

Trove will be coming offline on Tuesday to roll out the Monkey Business Edition patch. We'll bring the servers down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PST+February+16+2016]7 AM PST (3 PM GMT)[/URL] and expected down time is 3 hours.

I'll keep this post updated if we come back online early, or need a bit more time.

[B]Featured[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Chaos Week! The number of Chaos Chests you get each day due to Chaos Factor is doubled for this week. Top Chaos Chest loot is Shock (the Monkey) ally (be sure to /dance when you pick up this perky primate)!
[*]The Lunar New Year Dragon brood is here! With the new brood comes a brand new way to unlock dragons! 
[*]The Lunar New Year Dormant Egg is available for free at the in-game store. Combine this egg with Dragon Coins, Primordial Flame, and Flux at the Dragon Crucible underneath the Hub to unlock the legendary Selene, the Celestial Storm! This egg is available now through March 7th!
[*]A new, limited time, $100 Credit Pack is now on the store. This pack contains $100 worth of Credits and a bonus tradable Golden Lunar New Year Egg, which immediately hatches Selene, the Celestial Storm, with no additional materials required!
[/LIST]
[B]Game Updates[/B]
[LIST]
[*]The materials for creating Dragon Souls have been adjusted. In addition to 4 Dragon Coins (except for Azulian which costs 10 Dragon Coins) you’ll still need a Golden Soul, but the third ingredient (varies by souls) has been reduced by 50% or more.
[*]Crafting a Purified Dragon Flame now requires 50x Primordial Flames and 300x Radiant Shards, but no longer requires Dragon Coins. 
[*]The Dragon Coin Tome now grants 25 Dragon Coins per week when triggered. 
[*]5 Dragon Coins are now granted the first time you complete a Challenge on any given day. 
[*]Challenges now grant Lesser Dragon Caches when you complete the first two tiers. These caches contain flux, Dragon Coins, and, rarely, tradable Dragon Souls. 
[*]Completing the last tier of a challenge grants an additional guaranteed Dragon Coin
[*]Dragon Coins now deconstruct into 25 glim (down from 100)
[*]Previously existing Dragon Caches should now drop 3 coins at Uncommon (up from 1) and 20 coins at Rare (up from 5).
[*]Dragon Coins can no longer be traded, nor used as currency on the Auction House. 
[*]Dragon Souls crafted from the Dragon Crucible can no longer be traded. Any previously crafted Dragon Souls will remain tradable. 
[*]Origin Portals once again take you to the main spawn point of the world. 
[*]Patron now doubles daily Cubits earned from filling the star bar.
[/LIST]
[B]Trove Store[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Greater Dragon Caches added to the store! These new caches contain 10 Dragon Coins at common, 50 at uncommon, and very rarely a complete set of souls required for one of the existing dragons or a golden dragon egg (all tradable). Greater Dragon Caches are found in the Goods tab for 250 Credits.
[*]Dragon Coins can now be bought from the store 5 at a time for 750 Cubits (check the Goods tab)
[*]The legendary Tome of Growth (grants insta-growers) is back on the store!
[/LIST]
[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fix Intra-Club Transit portals still teleporting players to location of portals destroyed by terraforming. Those affected by this should now be able to teleport to the bad portal locations to cause the server to fix that bad teleport.
[*]Fixed a bug with the Wednesday fishing bonus where it wasn't applying the full speed increase (or even most of it).
[/LIST]

notes.title: Patch - Heart Attack Edition - 7AM PST (3PM GMT)
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/10/launch_blog_header-720x3221.jpg[/IMG]

Hey folks!

Trove will be coming offline on Tuesday to roll out the Heart Attack edition path. We'll bring the servers down at [url=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PST+February+9+2016]7 AM PST (3 PM GMT)[/url] and expected down time is 1 hour.

I'll keep this post updated if we come back online early, or need a bit more time. 

[B]Features[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Hellbug Invaders from Defiance have infested Trove just in time for Valentine’s Day. These Hellbugs are in love – with carnage!  Get unique Hellbug Adventure boxes and unlock the rare Bashful Lovebug.
[*]Power Rank is here! This new stat combines Mastery, Character Level, Unlocked Dragons, and Equipment Quality (including Allies, Flasks, and Emblems) into one number to rule them all.
[*]Portals formerly gated by level are now gated by Power Rank.
[*]The Power Rank Sigil now appears over the heads of players close to you. The Sigil is comprised of the shield (Power Rank) and wings (Mastery Rank). The higher the rank, the more ornate.
[*]Double Dragon! For this week only, your first Challenge completed each day will give TWO Starlight Dragon Souls!
[*]Heart-A-Phones are on sale this week for 90% off!
[/LIST]
[B]Game Updates[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Just in time for Valentine's Day, Heart-A-Phone stats are now tracked. Use "/stats" to see how many hearts you have received, and how many hearts you have sent. And in the end, the love you take is equal to the love you make, don't let numbers replace true companionship. These stats are not retroactive.
[*]Increased health pools on Uber 3 and higher to account for increased player damage. Depending on your mastery and dragon progress this may result in longer kill times, though for fully maxed and damage focused characters this will still be faster than it is now.
[*]We have updated daily bonuses, Wednesday is now faster fishing (goodbye forever Glim), Saturday is bonus adventure experience (XP) and Sunday is bonus PvP XP (winners only)
[*]Patron now doubles your daily bonuses.
[*]Each mastery rank up to 5 now requires 50 points to earn down from 100. Each rank from 6 to 10 now requires 75 points to earn also down from 100. 
[*]Using community and club chests and the trading post now require mastery rank 10 instead of 5.
[*]Mastery no longer gives stat bonuses at specific ranks
[*]Mastery no longer awards consumable or tradable items.
[*]Earn a non-tradable Class Coin at Mastery Rank 3 and 25 (granted automatically if you've already achieved those ranks).
[*]Mastery now gives +0.2% damage and +0.5% health per rank and contributes +1 Power Rank.
[*]Surestrike Emblem's duration is now 5 seconds (down from 6).
[*]Valorous Vial now has an internal cooldown on its effect to restore a flask charge, it will take about 15 seconds before it can trigger again
[*]NPCs now receive less damage while standing in lava.
[*]In addition to the stats already provided by dragon spirits, they now increase either damage by +250 or max health by +1000
[*]Enemies spawned by swarm quests now have vastly reduced health. More enemies are also required to win the quest, but swarm quests will be overall much faster to complete than before. We will be improving how quickly they spawn after death in a future update.
[*]When another player gets your Battle Trophy you are now notified.
[*]When a player acquires a GM/Dev Battle Trophy a unique message will be displayed.
[*]Following this patch all GM/Dev Battle Trophies dropped will also have a unique tooltip when viewed in your inventory or when the trophy block is inspected. This change is not retroactive.
[*]GMs and Devs can now opt to always drop trophies during PvP matches. You should definitely hunt them down.
[*]Some Shadow Tower floors are now have  more restrictive access requirements.
[/LIST]
[B]Trove Store[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Classes can no longer be purchased with Cubits. See above re: free classes via mastery. As always you can acquire tradable Class Coins via the Player Marketplace.
[*]There is now a free class coin on the Store for any players who have at least 5 Patron Points. Patron Points can be earned by purchasing real money items from the Trove Store.
[*]All existing class packs are now available as rotating store deals.
[*]New Chaos Chest Loot this week: Get 2 Xero Line wings or 2 at a time of all other rare weekly Chaos loot. Give one to your sweetheart! 
[*]The Chaos Chest  this week also has a rare result of 5 Heart a Phones. #YOLO #TrueLove
[*]You can now buy Omni Style Surprise in the Trove Store under the Goods tab for Credits and Cubits. When used, these will unlock a random equipment style that you don't already have unlocked!
[*]The Starter Pack has been updated! It now grants 5 days of Patron, the Sir Sebastian mount, 750 Credits, the Dark Hood helmet style, and a Class Coin!
[*]Power Pack has been updated! It now grants 15 days of Patron Pass in addition to: 2 Class Coins, 2000 of every Primal Block, Wings of the Phoenix, SS Trovian ship (with sail), Trovian Supecycle mount, and the Trove Topper helm. It no longer contains two flask coins.
[/LIST]
[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed bug where Fae Trickster's Blink ability sometimes didn't teleport at certain heights
[*]Fixed bug where only Club members could use the Portal crafting bench.
[*]Attempting to join Club members (who are not also friends) through the Club UI should work again.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Trove and Defiance: Hellbugs In Love Preview
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/02/blog_defiance-crossover.jpg[/IMG]

Valentine’s Day approaches and love is in the air! While you were out shopping for roses and heart-shaped boxes of chocolate, Defiance hellbugs have infested Trove’s shattered realms! Take part in this special crossover event to earn rewards in both Trove and Defiance.

[URL=http://store.steampowered.com/agecheck/app/224600/]Defiance is a third-person, futuristic, online open-world shooter[/URL] where thousands of players scour a transformed Earth competing for alien technology. Defiance is [B]Free to Play[/B] on [B]Windows[/B], [B]Xbox 360[/B] or [B]PS3[/B]!

[B]Hellbug Infestation[/B]
Start: [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=8AM+PST+February+9+2016]8AM PST (3PM GMT) – Tuesday, February 9, 2016[/URL]
End: [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PST+February+23+2016]7AM PST (2PM GMT) – Tuesday, February 23, 2016[/URL]

During this event you’ll be able to unlock two gorgeous hellbug mounts for Trove and the brand new Ground Pounder3 in Defiance!

To unlock your items in Trove:
[LIST]
[*]Defeat hellbug invaders in Trove to collect Skittering Heart Boxes for a chance to unlock the Pink Hellbug mount!
[*]Log into Defiance and take down 50 Monarch Hellbugs from the Colony Courtship Arkfalls to unlock the Red Hellbug mount in Trove
[/LIST]

To unlock your Defiance item:
[LIST]
[*]Log into Trove and reach Battle Rank 5 in PvP
[/LIST]

If you decide to play Defiance on console [URL=https://support.trionworlds.com/hc/en-us/articles/204183377]click here for instructions[/URL] on linking your console to your Glyph account to unlock these rewards.

Explore a partially terraformed future earth while collecting an arsenal of amazing weapons in Defiance then dive back into Trove where you can reshape the world and the only limit is your imagination!

notes.title: Rise to Power - Power Rank Preview
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/02/PowerRank.jpg[/IMG]

Display your power to the whole world with the new [B]Power Rank[/B] system!

Your [B]character level[/B], [B]Mastery[/B], [B]equipment[/B], and [B]unlocked dragons[/B] all contribute to create your Power Rank, the surefire way to show the world that you’re a boss!

Mouse over your Power Rank in the character sheet to see what is contributing to your current level.

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/02/PowerRankDisplay.png[/IMG]
Next to your Power Rank, you’ll see a [B]Sigil[/B] that also displays above your head for other players to see. The Sigil is a combination of shield (Power Rank) and wings (Mastery Rank). 

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/02/SigilDisplay.png[/IMG]

As you level up your character, increase your Mastery Rank, improve your gear, and unlock dragons, your Power Level will increase, making your Sigil more ornate (or "mor-nate," if you prefer).

notes.title: This Week In Trove - February 2nd, 2016
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/02/Adventure-Time.jpg[/IMG]

It’s a big week in Trove, so we’re going to call out a few things we think you’ll love. We’ve got so much to talk about that we’re flush with anticipation!

[LIST]
[*][B]Porter Potty[/B] – This brand new mount is available now but you’ll need guts to make this plucky porcelain potty. Just because you CAN craft it, does that mean you SHOULD craft it? Yes. Very much so.

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/02/gameofthrone.png[/IMG]
[*][b]Mimic Blocks[/B] – Ever miss the mark with your mining laser and wish you could fix that beautiful tree that really ties the room together? Trove abides. Craft Mimic Blocks at the Cube Converter and place them anywhere you need to patch things up. The blocks automatically mimic the color of any block they touch!
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/02/mimicblock.png[/IMG]

[*][B]Adventure Boxes[/B] – Get double drop rate for Adventure Boxes, and all the previous boxes have returned (except for the Shadow’s Eve version). Pick up these boxes while you're out on your adventures beating up baddies. 
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/02/AdventureBoxes.jpg[/IMG]

[*][B]Sir Sebastian[/B] – Sebastian finished his night classes on being hella classy, and has been promoted to Sir Sebastian. This elegant, educated equine is available for both Credits and Cubits in the Trove Store now!
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/02/sirsebastian.png[/IMG]

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/02/battleverse.jpg[/IMG]
[/LIST]

These are just a few of the additions we’ve added to Trove recently, but soon we’ll have even more to share! Be on the lookout for Power Rank to see just how powerful your Trovian can get!

notes.title: Patch - Game of Throne Edition - 7AM PST (3PM GMT) - 2/2/2016
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/10/launch_blog_header-720x3221.jpg[/IMG]

Hey folks!

We will be performing rolling out the Game of Throne Edition patch on Tuesday.

The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PST+February+2+2016]7 AM PST (3 PM GMT)[/URL] and expected down time is 60 minutes.

I'll keep this post updated if we come back online early, or need a bit more time.

[B]Features[/B]
[LIST]
[*]The game is afoot! You might now be able to craft the Porter Potty mount. Yes really. Maybe. Don't say we didn't warn you (also, thanks Milambit, for everything - but especially this).
[*]New Chaos Chest loot! Featuring Meownts and the BULL DOZER. 
[*]Adventure Box Madness! Adventure boxes drop at double rate, and all previous Adventure Boxes can drop (excluding Shadow's Eve Adventurer Chest)
[/LIST]
[B]Game Updates[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Mimic blocks are available now, and can be crafted at the Cube Converter!
[*]Loot celebrations now occur for rare Chaos Chest and Trove of Wonders loot! This will announce to your world chat that you’ve unlocked something awesome.
[*]The names of the original Alpha supporters are now displayed in game. Somewhere. We don’t talk about fight club. 
[*]The level requirement for Sky Realm loot has been lowered to 10. 
[*]Reduced some Cubit rewards for the Golden Thread tutorial. 
[*]Since it was easy to sometimes list an item for the wrong price and not realize it, added a comma separator for prices listed on the Marketplace (under both the Buy and Sell tab).
[*]Jump stat now represents total number of jumps instead number of air jumps (so falling off a ledge won’t consume a jump)
[*]Slow Sebastian is now slightly slower (he has a charley horse) 
[*]The "Vials" tab under Collections>Flasks has been renamed to "Flasks." 
[*]In Capture the Flag Battle Arenas the flag can now be returned by players who are carrying their opponent’s flag.
[*]Added Unit Price for items listed on the Buy Tab in the Marketplace. 
[*]Wings now have a "Glide" stat. The higher this stat, the slower you descend. 
[*]The Mastery Rank 5 wings now have a lower Glide stat.
[*]Wings given through Mastery are now under the "Mastery" heading in the Collections>Wings window 
[*]In the Character Sheet when switching to the Mastery or Battle Level tabs, it will now auto-scroll to your current progress.
[/LIST]
[B]Trove Store[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Added a new 'Sir Sebastian' mount to the Trove Store, available for both Credits and Cubits .
[*]Adjusted Cubit prices in the Trove Store to ten times the number of Credits (the largest price changes are for the Overload Omniseat and Loveseat mounts). 
[*]Cubit cost of classes remains the same, so stock up now!
[*]Some Emblems have had their price increased to unify pricing.
[/LIST]
[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Black rectangles in Chloromancer - Evergreen Evoker's costume have been removed. 
[*]Fix intra-club linked portals teleporting to invalid location.
[/LIST]
Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: Update 2 - Extended Database Migration - 6AM PST (2PM GMT) - January 19, 2016
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/01/ChromaticCumulus.jpg[/IMG]

[B]Update 2 [/B]- 12:25 PM PST (8:25 PM GMT) - We're online, but there will be a queue for a while. Unfortunately, there's a bug that is causing your queue time to show up as [B]{0}. Estimated Wait {1}[/B]. This is just a display issue, and you are moving forward in the queue. We'll get a fix for that out is soon as possible.

[B]Update 1[/B] – [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=5%3A45+PM+PST+January+20+2016]5:45 PST (1:45 AM GMT)[/URL]:

Hey all,

Andrew "Avarem" Krausnick, here.

We wanted to provide you with an update on our progress: right now the data transfer is moving more slowly than we had initially anticipated.

While the transfer is going well, and we’ve moved a substantial amount of data to the new hardware (fun fact: the number of Trove characters ever made is in the millions.), we are going to need additional time for it to complete and run our internal tests of the new system.

To be sure that we allow enough time to clear the tasks that remain, we’re adding an additional 24 hours to our expected downtime. We hope to be online by [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=6+AM+PST+January+22+2016]6AM PST (2PM GMT) on January 22nd[/URL].


Believe me, we want to get back in game as much (or possibly more!) than you do and we would rather extend our outage than rush something this important. As always, thanks for bearing with us as we make these improvements and we appreciate your patience.

------

Greetings Trovians,

The big day is here! We're going offline on Tuesday to start the transfer to our brand new database.

The servers will go offline at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=6+AM+PST+January+19+2016]6:00 AM PST (2:00 PM GMT)[/URL] and expected downtime is 48 hours.

It's possible that things will go quickly, and we'll be online sooner, or that things may progress more slowly and we will need additional time. Either way, we'll keep this announcement up to date with the latest.

During the downtime we will be [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/304050/announcements/detail/807635688206510606]hosting a Trove livestream[/url], and Avarem will be doing a Reddit AMA (Ask Me Anything), so be on the lookout for more info regarding both of those events.

Thanks very much for your patience. We'll see you soon!

To be sure that we allow enough time to clear the tasks that remain, we’re adding an additional 24 hours to our expected downtime. We hope to be online by [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=6+AM+PST+January+22+2016]6AM PST (2PM GMT) on January 22nd[/URL].


Believe me, we want to get back in game as much (or possibly more!) than you do and we would rather extend our outage than rush something this important. As always, thanks for bearing with us as we make these improvements and we appreciate your patience.

------

Greetings Trovians,

The big day is here! We're going offline on Tuesday to start the transfer to our brand new database.

The servers will go offline at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=6+AM+PST+January+19+2016]6:00 AM PST (2:00 PM GMT)[/URL] and expected downtime is 48 hours.

It's possible that things will go quickly, and we'll be online sooner, or that things may progress more slowly and we will need additional time. Either way, we'll keep this announcement up to date with the latest.

During the downtime we will be [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/304050/announcements/detail/807635688206510606]hosting a Trove livestream[/url], and Avarem will be doing a Reddit AMA (Ask Me Anything), so be on the lookout for more info regarding both of those events.

Thanks very much for your patience. We'll see you soon!

notes.title: Extended Downtime - 48 Hour Data Migration - 1/19/2016
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/09/launch_blog_header-720x322.jpg[/IMG]

Greetings Trovians!

Uptime and stability improvements have been our technical teams’ #1 priority.  We’d like to share the next important step: A full upgrade and replacement of our data storage system to one that can handle Trove’s scale.

For the last few weeks we’ve been testing our new storage system on the on the Public Test Server.  We’re happy to say that it’s gone well, and it’s time to do it live! However, it's going to take some time - up to 48 hours to complete the full upgrade.

[B]Trove Extended Downtime – 48 Hours[/B]
[B]Start[/B] –[URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=6+AM+PST+January+19+2016] 6:00 AM PST (3:00 PM GMT) – January 19, 2016[/URL]
[B]Finish[/B] – [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=6+AM+PST+January+21+2016]6:00 AM PST (3:00 PM GMT) – January 21, 2016[/URL]

In addition to the long term improvements, we’re offering special bonuses and loot for everyone once Trove is back online. Sign into Trove after the downtime, but before [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=11%3A59+PM+PST+January+24+2016]11:59 PM PST January 24th[/URL] to receive:

[LIST]
[*][B]Chromatic Cumulus mount[/B] – A cloud mount complete with rainbow! (pictured below)
[*][B]5 days of Patron Status[/B] for Trovians Mastery rank 20 and above!
[*]Active Patrons will receive an [B]additional 5 Patron days[/B]!
[*][B]2x Battle Exp[/B] in Trove PvP through January 24th!
[/LIST]

[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/01/ChromaticCumulus.jpg[/IMG]

[I]Why is the downtime needed?[/I]

Trove has outgrown the original database that stored game data. With the number of players creating the vast, intricate Club Worlds, we used up a lot of our data storage very quickly. With the existing system being overworked, we started to see stability issues. This is why we have trouble bringing the game back online as quickly as we’d like after a crash, and why we perform scheduled maintenance on both Tuesday and Friday.

To resolve these issues, we’ve purchased all new database hardware, and are transitioning to a bigger and more efficient method of storing game information. The amount of data being moved is massive, so we’re going to need an extended downtime for this transfer. We’re expecting to have up to 48 hours of downtime starting on 1/19/2016. The extra time will allow us to bring the system offline, transfer the existing game data to the new database, and run tests to be sure everything is working as it should. Your [B]consecutive days will not reset[/B] during this downtime. Once we're back online, if you notice an issue with your consecutive days, let us know and we'll check it out.

[I]What can we expect once Trove is back online?[/I]

We can’t promise that this is a magic bullet solution that will fix every issue, but it is a huge leap forward. In the weeks following the database migration we should start to see substantial improvements in server stability, reduction in downtime needed, and quicker restarts if anything unexpected should happen.

This database migration will put us on a solid foundation for all the adventures to come!

notes.title: Starlight Dragons take to the skies of Trove!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/01/StarlightDragon.jpg[/IMG]

Starlight, star bright, first star I see tonight, I wish I may, I wish I might, unlock this crazy awesome dragon!

[B]Starlight Dragon Caches[/B] are available by beating [B]Challenges[/B], as well as in the [B]Trove Store[/B]. When you receive a [B]Dragon Soul[/B] from one of these caches, you can consume it to imbue your [B]Starlight Dragon[/B] with power.

[B]1 Dragon Soul[/B] – Receive the [B]Starlight Dragoncrown[/B] helm
[B]5 Dragon Souls[/B]- Unlock the [B]Starlight Dragonling[/B] ally
[B]10 Dragon Souls[/B] – Earn the [B]Starlight Fledgling[/B] ground mount
[B]25 Dragon Souls[/B] – [B]Starlight Dragon Arsenal[/B] grants five new weapon styles! Starlight Saber, Meteoric Mageblade, Galactic Coil, and Shooting Starwing
[B]50 Dragon Souls[/B] – Take to the skies on the [B]Starlight Dragon[/B] gliding mount
[B]75 Dragon Souls[/B] – Receive a permanent buff, [B]Starlight Aura[/B], that grants 500 Magic Damage, +1 Jump, and +50 Magic Find. You’ll also unlock the Starlight Dragon radiant aura
[B]100 Dragon Souls[/B] – The legendary [B]Stellaurion, Charter of Constellations[/B] is yours to command

As always, you’ll get a guaranteed Dragon Soul for the [B]first Challenge completed each day[/B]. The [URL=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i1WRYoM6vRM]Starlight Express[/URL] is barreling into 2016. All aboard!

notes.title: Wreak Chaos - Brand New Chaos Chest Loot!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2016/01/TROVE_POSE_Mount_BoneAndBloodThrone_01.jpg[/IMG]

notes.title: Trove Unboxed – Multiple Cornerstones!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/06/unboxed_blog_header-720x3222.jpg[/IMG]    

What’s better than having a unique Cornerstone to call home? Four unique Cornerstones! With multiple Cornerstones, now you can pick the one that best suits your mood!

Maybe you want a custom Cornerstone to represent each season. Perhaps you want to finally see a faithful adaptation of the Fantastic Four, and can’t wait for the movies to get it right. No matter what the reason, the time has come to stretch your imagination to the limits!
[LIST]
[*]Press the F1 key then click on the Cornerstones menu option
[*]Click the pencil icon if you’d like to rename your Cornerstones for easier tracking
[*]Unlock up to four Cornerstone slots using Credits or Cubits
[*]Once you’ve unlocked additional slots, click the Switch button to change your Cornerstone (there will be a delay of several seconds before you can switch again)
[*]Break down the default Cornerstone model and build the home of your dreams!
[*]Use the trash can icon on the Cornerstone menu to reset any Cornerstone to default. Any placed items will be permanently deleted, so pick them up before deleting a Cornerstone!
[/LIST]
Access the Cornerstone menu from anywhere, pick the design that fits your needs, and show off your creativity to the world (of Trove)!

notes.title: Class Preview: The Chloromancer Takes Root
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/12/Chloromancer.jpg[/IMG]

Stemming from the [URL=http://www.trionworlds.com/rift/en/game/classes/]RIFT class[/URL], but with roots firmly planted in Trove, the Chloromancer proves that sometimes it IS easy being green!

Chlorophylled to the max with flower power, this leafy legionnaire brings Trove healing to a whole new level. Don’t think of this gluten free guardian as a one trick poinsettia, because the Chloromancer also brings brute force to the table.

Your main attack (left mouse button) casts bolts of natural magic that pass through fellow players and minions, healing them, while simultaneously causing damage to enemies. 

[B]Phytobarrier (Passive)[/B]
When the Chloromancer’s health drops below 50%, a shield goes up, absorbing an amount of damage based on your maximum health.

[B]Leafy Lasher (right-click)[/B]
Toss a plant that grows over time – you can speed up the growth with your main attack. Once the plant has reached full power, it unleashes a whirlwind attack that damages and snares all nearby foes. Up to five leafy lashers can be active at a time.

[B]Blooming Pollinator (1)[/B]
Throw a healing flower that can be empowered by your main attack. While the plant is blooming, it heals any nearby players, but upon reaching full power, the flower erupts, damaging all enemies caught in the wake.

[B]Sow Chaos (2)[/B]
Spawn a seedling that hops around the Chloromancer, gleefully planting lash vines and healing flowers – both grow more quickly as you empower them. This ability is great for slowing enemies in a larger area, and brings the pain!

If you reach level 10 on any Trove class, you’ll automatically unlock a unique RIFT cloak from the Plane of Cubes for all your RIFT characters! Bring any Trove class to level 20 and unlock Vox, the Budgie mount in RIFT! 

You’ll also be able to unlock the Chloromancer in Trove, for free, by completing a quest in RIFT. The quest is called “Blocked!” and will be granted by [B]Chloromancer Evort in Sanctum or Meridian[/B] (starting December 15th). If you’re [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/39120/]new to RIFT[/url], you’ll need to complete the tutorial before you can pick up this quest.

Every rose has its thorn, and every cowboy sings a sad, sad song. Show off your flower power when the Chloromancer blooms on [B]December 15th[/B]!

notes.title: Trove PvP – Enter the Battleverse!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/12/blog.jpg[/img]

Square off against Trovians the world over in the brutal [B]Battle Arena Battleverse[/B]! Fight for honor, for glory, for pwnage, and for exclusive PvP loot!

Challenge teams of cubic combatants in fast-paced Capture the Flag action. As you gain experience in the [B]Battle Arena[/B], you’ll increase your [B]Battle Level[/B]. As you rank up, you’ll receive [B]Battle Factor[/B]. Battle Factor determines the maximum number of [B]Battle Boxes[/B] you can earn each week. Battle Boxes contain banners your character can equip. Each banner grants additional stats that vary by quality, and are only active when in PvP combat.

The equipped banner also modifies the benefits received from grabbing Power Ups on the field of battle; pick one that suits your play style! You can break down banners in the Loot Collector to earn [B]Arena Tokens[/B]. Spend these at the [B]Battle Broker[/B] (located next to the Battle Arena portal in the Hub) to unlock unique PvP mounts that will show off your banner for all to see! 

The [B]Blue Battle Tiger[/B], [B]Grey War Wolf[/B], and [B]Blue Terror Turtle[/B]

Active Trove Patrons will receive a Battle Chest every 40 minutes of play, until you’ve reached your cap for the week. Non-Patrons will receive a Battle Chest every 80 minutes of played time, until they have received one per point of Battle Factor as well.

The Battleverse isn’t just about battle, it also brings new ways to build. Use an [B]Arena Terraformer[/B] (crafted at the [B]Worldspring[/B]) in your [B]Club World[/B] to place the foundation for your very own custom Battle Arena! 

You get to decide where each team starts, where the flag spawns, where captured flags are returned, the location of every power up, and even place turrets to keep combatants on their toes! Once you’ve finished building your arena, place a [B]Battle Arena portal[/B]. Invite your friends, phone the neighbors; anyone using this portal will be able to compete on your map.

Put your diabolical genius to the test by creating unique fields of battle, the likes of which have never been seen. The only limit is [URL=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r2pt2-F2j2g]your imagination[/URL]!

[LIST]

[LIST]

[*]Patron status now grants double Battle Factor and doubles your drop rate of Battle Boxes

[*]The Bull Dozer mount and Big Bomb legendary tome are available for sale on the Trove Store individually as well as in the Builder’s Pack
[*]Upgraded terraformer visuals. Now a glowing grid will show you the exact areas that will be destroyed and remade by your terraforming!
[*]Basic attack projectiles are now faster

[*]Movement speed now 25% faster in the Battle Arena (PvP)

[B]New Packs on the Trove Store! [/B]

[I]Collector’s Pack[/I] (One per account)
[LIST]
[*]12 Omni Mount Unlockers (unlock any Meownt, Pemblock, or Adventure Mount you don’t already have)
[*]100 Omni Style Unlockers (designed by Tribe) – Unlocks an equipment style you don’t already have
[*]Hat of hats – An extra tall hat designed by Tribe
[*]2 Golden Chaos Chests
[/LIST]

[I]Creator’s Pack[/I] (One per account)
[LIST]
[*]Bull Dozer – A new steam powered bull mount that can destroy blocks in your Club World as you ride (designed by Screamheart)
[*]Big Bomb Legendary Tome – Get 40 big bombs, for free, once a week (great for destroying large collections of blocks)
[*]A ton of blocks and ore to get you building: 500 infinium, 1000 formicite, 5000 shapestone, 9999 of each primal block, 50 Omni decoration recipes (unlocks any decoration recipes you don’t already have unlocked).
[/LIST]

[I]Radiant Pack[/I] (One per account. Requires Mastery Rank 10.) 
[LIST]
[*]Includes all resources needed to take a Resplendent item up to Radiant quality
[*]9999 Flux
[*]999 Eyes of Qubthulu
[*]2 Twice Forged Shadow Soul
[*]2 Thrice Forged Shadow Soul
[*]2 Quad Forged Shadow Soul
[*]3 penta forged shadow Soul
[*]3 Purified Flame
[/LIST]

[I]Battle Pack[/I] (One per account. Requires Mastery Rank 10.)
[LIST]
[*]20 Battle Boxes
[*]Permanent +2 Battle Factor
[*]A War Tiger, War Wolf, and Terror Turtle variant (designed by FriedSushi)
[/LIST]

[B]Battle Arena Rewards[/B]
[LIST]
[*]The Trove Battle Arena now grants rewards!
[*]Compete in the arena to increase your Battle Level
[*]Increasing your Battle Level unlocks rewards, including auras, mounts, and Battle Factor
[*]Battle Factor determines the maximum number of Battle Boxes you can earn each week
[*]Battle Boxes drop randomly while playing, but you won't get credit towards the next one if you leave games before they end.
[*]Classic Battle Boxes will contain a Battle Banner that grants PvP stats when equipped in the brand new Banner slot on the Character sheet (C) 
[*]Your equipped Battle Banner will also modify the power ups received in Battle Arena matches
[*]Break down Battle Banners in the Loot Collector to receive Arena Coins, which can be spent at the Battle Broker vendors located next to the Battle Arena portal in the Hub
[/LIST]

[B]Custom Battle Arenas[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Build your own custom Battle Arenas in Club Worlds that receive the same rewards as the Battle Arenas in the Hub!
[*]Create custom spawn points, flag spawns, and capture points for both teams. In addition, you can place turrets, flags of strife and powerup spawn points throughout your map.
[*]Craft tag blocks and the Battle Arena portal for custom matches at the Worldspring
[*]Replaced turrets in cornerstones with PvP turret tagblocks. If you place these blocks in your custom PvP map, they will be transformed into active turrets when the game begins.
[*]You can start a custom arena match before 10 players have joined a match by using the command /testarena, but these matches will not grant rewards
[/LIST]

[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed bug where Lunar Lancer could become unable to use abilities after mashing the M2 ability
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed the Lunar Lancer to carry a flag while grappling
[*]Fixed a bug where Boomeranger didn’t always get cooldown reduction after catching a boomerang
[/LIST]

[I]Collector’s Pack[/I] (One per account)
[LIST]
[*]12 Omni Mount Unlockers (unlock any Meownt, Pemblock, or Adventure Mount you don’t already have)
[*]100 Omni Style Unlockers (designed by Tribe) – Unlocks an equipment style you don’t already have
[*]Hat of hats – An extra tall hat designed by Tribe
[*]2 Golden Chaos Chests
[/LIST]

[I]Creator’s Pack[/I] (One per account)
[LIST]
[*]Bull Dozer – A new steam powered bull mount that can destroy blocks in your Club World as you ride (designed by Screamheart)
[*]Big Bomb Legendary Tome – Get 40 big bombs, for free, once a week (great for destroying large collections of blocks)
[*]A ton of blocks and ore to get you building: 500 infinium, 1000 formicite, 5000 shapestone, 9999 of each primal block, 50 Omni decoration recipes (unlocks any decoration recipes you don’t already have unlocked).
[/LIST]

[I]Radiant Pack[/I] (One per account. Requires Mastery Rank 10.) 
[LIST]
[*]Includes all resources needed to take a Resplendent item up to Radiant quality
[*]9999 Flux
[*]999 Eyes of Qubthulu
[*]2 Twice Forged Shadow Soul
[*]2 Thrice Forged Shadow Soul
[*]2 Quad Forged Shadow Soul
[*]3 penta forged shadow Soul
[*]3 Purified Flame
[/LIST]

[I]Battle Pack[/I] (One per account. Requires Mastery Rank 10.)
[LIST]
[*]20 Battle Boxes
[*]Permanent +2 Battle Factor
[*]A War Tiger, War Wolf, and Terror Turtle variant (designed by FriedSushi)
[/LIST]

[B]Battle Arena Rewards[/B]
[LIST]
[*]The Trove Battle Arena now grants rewards!
[*]Compete in the arena to increase your Battle Level
[*]Increasing your Battle Level unlocks rewards, including auras, mounts, and Battle Factor
[*]Battle Factor determines the maximum number of Battle Boxes you can earn each week
[*]Battle Boxes drop randomly while playing, but you won't get credit towards the next one if you leave games before they end.
[*]Classic Battle Boxes will contain a Battle Banner that grants PvP stats when equipped in the brand new Banner slot on the Character sheet (C) 
[*]Your equipped Battle Banner will also modify the power ups received in Battle Arena matches
[*]Break down Battle Banners in the Loot Collector to receive Arena Coins, which can be spent at the Battle Broker vendors located next to the Battle Arena portal in the Hub

[B]Custom Battle Arenas[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Build your own custom Battle Arenas in Club Worlds that receive the same rewards as the Battle Arenas in the Hub!
[*]Create custom spawn points, flag spawns, and capture points for both teams. In addition, you can place turrets, flags of strife and powerup spawn points throughout your map.
[*]Craft tag blocks and the Battle Arena portal for custom matches at the Worldspring
[*]Replaced turrets in cornerstones with PvP turret tagblocks. If you place these blocks in your custom PvP map, they will be transformed into active turrets when the game begins.

[LIST]
[*]Fixed bug where Lunar Lancer could become unable to use abilities after mashing the M2 ability
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed the Lunar Lancer to carry a flag while grappling
[*]Fixed a bug where Boomeranger didn’t always get cooldown reduction after catching a boomerang
[/LIST]

notes.title: It's Beginning To Look a Lot Like Snowfest!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/11/Snowfest.jpg[/IMG]

Winter is coming and the weatherman has called for Snowfest!

Let the frosty fury of flurries begin! Beat up on baddies throughout Adventure Worlds and the Shadow Tower to stock up on [B]Snowfest Mystery Boxes[/B]. These adventure boxes offer up a blustery bounty of winter styles and recipes, as well as a chance at the rare [B]Snowman mount [/B]or [B]Sleigh Mag Rider[/B]. 

Not only that, but [b]Winter Piñatas[/b] have returned, and they are loaded with wintry wonders like the [b]Winter Piñata mount[/b], the [b]Chilly Pin Head[/b], the [b]Slope Slider hat[/b] and much more! 

To top things off, the [B]Santa Barbarian costume[/B] and [B]Rudolph Raptor mount[/B] are back on the [B]Trove Store[/B]!

Get in on the coolest holiday season of the year, now through January 5th!

notes.notes:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]

Update 1: We're online a bit early today. Enjoy Snowfest!

We'll be bringing the Trove servers offline on Tuesday to roll out the Snowfest patch.

The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PST+December+1+2015]7AM PST / 3 PM GMT[/URL] and expected downtime is 4 hours.

I'll update this post if we come back online early, or need any additional time.

Thanks!

[B]Features[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Winter is coming, and the Winter Dragon brood has arrived!
[*]The Hub has been updated in honor of Snowfest
[*]The Winter Piñata returns to the Trove Store!
[*]It’s a Snowfest miracle: the Santa Barbarian costume has returned to the Trove Store!
[*]Two winter mounts are back in action: Rudolph Raptor and Reveling Reindeer!
[*]Fish at double speed all week!
[*]Chaos Chests have been updated. Top loot this week is the Metalhead Mag Rider!

[LIST]
[*]Challenges now show up at Mastery Rank 10
[*]Sky Portal and Shadow Tower Portal are now significantly cheaper to craft

[*]Wings are now unlocked at Mastery Rank 5 while Qubesly unlocks at Mastery Rank 10

[/LIST]
[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed bug where Shadow Hunter's Radiant Arrow didn't do extra damage to marked targets 
[*]Fixed bug where Shadow Hunter's ultimate Radiant Arrow and Gunslinger's instant-charged Charge Shot fired on their own after a few seconds while holding down the attack button 
[*]Fixed Shadow Hunter bug where charging a Radiant Arrow immediately after triggering Arrow of the Goddess sometimes caused the arrow to fire without dealing damage 
[*]Fixed bug in the Battle Arena (PvP) where the Shadow Hunter's Sun Snare could be triggered by the Shadow Hunter and teammates
[/LIST]

notes.title: It’s Block Friday – I’m In Love!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/11/blog2.jpg[/IMG]

All this week we’re celebrating [B]Block Friday[/B], and it’s your chance to get the best deals of the year!

Our [B][URL=http://steamcommunity.com/games/304050/announcements/detail/750205285048503880]Autumn Piñatas[/URL][/B] are about to fall out of the [B]Trove Store[/B], so stuff your stockings while you still can. We've added Autumn styles and the piñata helm to the possible loot, and removed the Candy Corn. Not only that, but they are also half price until [B]December 1st![/B]

A stack of packs are returning to the Trove Store (buy them in game using your Steam Wallet) for this week only! [B]Save 50%[/B] on these cool collections before they disappear!
[LIST]
[*][B]The Power Pack[/B]- Get two class coins, flask tokens, wings, stuff for building, costume, a mount, a ship, and so much more!
[*][B]Block Beards Pirate Pack[/B] – Unlock the Pirate Captain class, two ships, a unique sail, and two costumes!
[*][B]Blitz and Glitz Costume Pack[/B] – Eight of the glitziest costumes in all of Trove, including the Shadow’s Disciple, Dark Infineon, and the Lunar Ronin!
[*][B]Adventure Pack [/B]– Take a walk on the wild side with the cunning Boomeranger class along with two flasks, two costumes, and five emblems!
[*][B]To the Nines Costume Pack[/B] – Pick up this costume pack to unlock nine costumes created by players just like you!
[*][B]Necrofancy Pack[/B] – Delve into the dark arts with the Tomb Raiser class, two unique costumes, the Boneweaver and Spite Biter spider mounts, and the magnificent Soulfire Wings!
[*][B]Lunacy Pack[/B] – You want to get nuts? Come on, let’s get nuts! Unleash the Lunar Lancer class, two costumes, two mounts, and two tomes that you can level up to unlock rewards every week!
[/LIST]
Winter is coming. Treat yourself to these hot deals before they vanish on December 1st!

notes.title: Update 7 - Patch - Block Friday Edition - 11/24/2015 - 7AM PST / 3 PM GMT
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://webcdn.triongames.com/patcher/glyph-all/hotfix_trove.jpg[/IMG]


[B]Update 7:[/B] (6:20 PM PST / 2:20 AM GMT) We'll be unlocking the servers soon, but will have queues as we monitor our status. 

[B]Update 6:[/B] (5:20 PM PST / 1:20 AM GMT) Servers are restarting, and we'll be doing some testing. Expect another update in 1 hour, if we're still offline.

[B]Update 5:[/B] (3:30 PM PST / 11:30 PM GMT) To resolve the issues we've been experiencing since our previous crash, we're going to bring everything offline, and restart all services while we monitor performance. I'll post another update in 2 hours, if we haven't already come back online.

Update 4: (2:45 PM PST / 10:45 PM GMT) Unfortunately, we've had a server crash, but we're in the process of bringing the game back online. We're continuing to make adjustments to resolve the server stability issues so we can remove the queues, but please bear with us.

[B]Update 3: [/B](11:55 AM PST / 7:55 PM GMT) Trove is back online. We've set a fairly low population cap while we keep an eye on things, so there will be some queues.

[B]Update 2: [/B] (11:45 AM PST / 7:45 PM GMT) We've restarted our servers and are running additional checks before we get things unlocked. I'll post again in 60 minutes if we haven't yet come online already.

[b]Update 1: (10:20 AM PST / 6:20 PM GMT)[/b] After unlocking the game, we began to see unexpected errors pop up. We're bringing the game offline again to do some additional maintenance, and I'll update this thread with news in 90 minutes, if we're not back online.

Hey folks!

We will be performing maintenance and rolling out the Block Friday patch on Tuesday.

The servers will come down at [URL=http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=7+AM+PST+November+24+2015]7 AM PDT / 3 PM GMT[/URL] and expected down time is 4.5 hours. 

I'll keep this post updated if we come back online early, or need a bit more time.

Thanks for your patience!

[B]Features[/B]
* Chaos Chests have been updated! Top loot this week are the Wings of Shadowy Descent!
* Block Friday Sale! Get 50% off the following from the Trove Store (yup, you can use your Steam Wallet!):[LIST]
[*]The Power Pack
[*]Block Beards Pirate 
[*]Blitz and Glitz Costume 
[*]Adventure Pack 
[*]To the Nines Costume Pack 
[*]Necrofancy Pack 
[*]Lunacy Pack
[/LIST]

[B]Autumn Piñata Update[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Save 50% on Autumn Piñatas 
[*]They are disappearing next week, so now is the last chance to stock up!
[*]These piñatas now drop Autumn Recipes and the helm style, but no longer drop Candy Corn
[/LIST]

[B]Game Updates[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Doubled projectile speed of radiant arrow on Shadow Hunter
[*]Thursday's bonus drops now only apply to Adventure Boxes and Event Box drops. Pemblocks and Meownts are now more rare. 
[*]Cursed Vale Terraformer has been added to the Worldspring
[*]Moved the output of /stats back to the chat window. 
[*]Improved the mining laser. Block desync while mining should now be exceedingly rare. 
[*]Slight change to timestamp format for Club logs.
[*]Loot pickup text moved back to right side of screen
[/LIST]

[B]Bug Fixes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed a bug where Shadow Tower Portals remained open forever on Cornerstones 
[*]Fixed some instances where other players didn't animate while using abilities 
[*]Tome rewards will now go into overflow inventory if your inventory is full 
[*]Fixed a bug where grass was sometimes not destroyed when shot by projectiles 
[*]Fixed a bug where Shadow Hunter's Radiant Arrow sometimes didn't damage enemies if it first went through a wall, or another enemy 
[*]Fixed general bug where enemies and terrain sometimes didn't get hit by projectiles if the projectile first pierced another object
[*]Fixed a broken ability combination. You know the one.
[*]Game Pads: Fix camera thumb stick sometimes not working immediately after changing thumb stick invert in Settings
[*]Fixed an issue that cause World chat to become broken if it was being used while changing worlds. 
[*]Club logs will now display item names correctly
[*]Fixed bug where blocks placed on the client would disappear after a couple of seconds. This can still happen due to a valid server correction, but it should be infrequent.
[/LIST]

notes.title: Turkeytopia Has Returned – Up and Autumn!
notes.notes:
[IMG]http://www.trionworlds.com/trove/wp-content/uploads/sites/7/2015/11/turkey.png[/IMG]

With the return of Turkeytopia comes the dreaded Dream Gobbler invaders, and these turkeys are in a fowl mood!

Stand guard against these gobbling goblins to unlock a cornucopia of holiday goodies like the [B]Appeased Dream Gobbler[/B] or [B]Trotting Turkey[/B] mounts!
